item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28580","type":"Note","attachment":[],"attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ERepublican congress seeks SA AGOA suspension over Taiwan, Hamas\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMEMBERS of the US Congress have written to President Trump urging him to revoke South Africa\u0026#8217;s AGOA preferential trade privileges. They cite the countries support of Hamas, (a listed terrorist organisation), the removal of the Taiwanese embassy in Pretoria, in addition to \u0026#8216;destructive land reform policies\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;consistent infidelity to the rule of law\u0026#8217;, as violation of eligibility criteria for AGOA,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFour congressional members including Andrew Ogles, Joe Wilson, Tom Tiffany and Don Bacon penned a letter last week, claiming the United States had been marginalised\u00a0 under the ANC, and if Pretoria did not act \u0026#8216;constructively\u0026#8217;, to rather pursue a path that includes suspension of diplomatic ties and removal of trade privileges, in addition to sanctions.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump recently signed a presidential order suspending aid to South Africa, and granting refugee status to its white minority Afrikaner community over\u00a0 the signing into law of a \u0026#8216;confiscation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; land reform bill. The new law opens the door to state seizure of private property in South Africa, in contravention of the constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPretoria\u0026#8217;s consistent undermining of US interests include \u0026#8220;the filing of a baseless claim\u0026#8221; before the International Court of Justice following the 7\/10 murder of 1 200 Jews including American citizens. The congressmen are upset that South Africa claims Israel wants to destroy the Palestinians, while it enjoys close ties to Hamas, allowing two \u0026#8220;Hamas-controlled charities\u0026#8221; the Al Aqsa Foundation and Al Quds Foundation to operate freely within our borders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;For decades, officials of the South African government have acted as Hamas propagandists, urging the international community to lift trade sanctions and otherwise engage with the US-designated foreign terrorist organisation.\u0026#8221; The Islamist group whose charter calls for the elimination of Israel and its replacement by a clerical dictatorship under a Pan-Arab constellation of states, is opposed to the secular rights and freedoms outlined by South Africa\u0026#8217;s own constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ERepublican congress seeks SA AGOA suspension over Taiwan, Hamas\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMEMBERS of the US Congress have written to President Trump urging him to revoke South Africa\u0026#8217;s AGOA preferential trade privileges. The new law opens the door to state seizure of private property in South Africa, in contravention of the constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPretoria\u0026#8217;s consistent undermining of US interests include \u0026#8220;the filing of a baseless claim\u0026#8221; before the International Court of Justice following the 7\/10 murder of 1 200 Jews including American citizens. The congressmen are upset that South Africa claims Israel wants to destroy the Palestinians, while it enjoys close ties to Hamas, allowing two \u0026#8220;Hamas-controlled charities\u0026#8221; the Al Aqsa Foundation and Al Quds Foundation to operate freely within our borders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;For decades, officials of the South African government have acted as Hamas propagandists, urging the international community to lift trade sanctions and otherwise engage with the US-designated foreign terrorist organisation.\u0026#8221; The Islamist group whose charter calls for the elimination of Israel and its replacement by a clerical dictatorship under a Pan-Arab constellation of states, is opposed to the secular rights and freedoms outlined by South Africa\u0026#8217;s own constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-02-18T06:23:38Z","tag":[],"url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/02\/18\/republican-congress-seeks-sa-agoa-suspension-over-taiwan-hamas\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

They cite the countries support of \u003Cspan class=\u0022BxUVEf ILfuVd\u0022 lang=\u0022en\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022hgKElc\u0022\u003EHarakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E (Hamas), the forced removal of the Taiwanese embassy in Pretoria, in addition to \u0026#8216;destructive land reform policies\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;consistent infidelity to the rule of law\u0026#8217;, as violation of eligibility criteria for AGOA,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFour congressional members including Andrew Ogles, Joe Wilson, Tom Tiffany and Don Bacon \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/morrow_nw\/status\/1891571125253005794\u0022\u003Epenned a letter last week\u003C\/a\u003E, claiming the United States had been marginalised\u00a0 under the ANC, and if Pretoria did not act \u0026#8216;constructively\u0026#8217;, to rather pursue a path that includes suspension of diplomatic ties and removal of trade privileges, in addition to sanctions.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump recently signed a presidential order suspending aid to South Africa, and granting refugee status to its white minority Afrikaner community over\u00a0 the signing into law of a \u0026#8216;confiscation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; land reform bill. The new law opens the door to state seizure of private property in South Africa, in contravention of the constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPretoria\u0026#8217;s consistent undermining of US interests include \u0026#8220;the filing of a baseless claim\u0026#8221; before the International Court of Justice following the 7\/10 \u0026#8216;murder of 1 200 Jews including American citizens\u0026#8217;. The congressmen are upset that South Africa claims Israel wants to \u0026#8216;destroy the Palestinians\u0026#8217;, while it enjoys close ties to Hamas, allowing two \u0026#8220;Hamas-controlled charities\u0026#8221; the Al Aqsa Foundation and Al Quds Foundation to operate freely within our borders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;For decades, officials of the South African government have acted as Hamas propagandists, urging the international community to lift trade sanctions and otherwise engage with the US-designated foreign terrorist organisation.\u0026#8221; The Islamist group whose charter calls for the elimination of Israel and its replacement by a clerical dictatorship under a Pan-Arab constellation of states, is opposed to the secular rights and freedoms outlined by South Africa\u0026#8217;s own constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ERepublican congress seeks SA AGOA suspension over Taiwan, Hamas\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMEMBERS of the US Congress have written to President Trump urging him to revoke South Africa\u0026#8217;s AGOA preferential trade privileges. They cite the countries support of \u003Cspan class=\u0022BxUVEf ILfuVd\u0022 lang=\u0022en\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022hgKElc\u0022\u003EHarakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E (Hamas), the forced removal of the Taiwanese embassy in Pretoria, in addition to \u0026#8216;destructive land reform policies\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;consistent infidelity to the rule of law\u0026#8217;, as violation of eligibility criteria for AGOA,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFour congressional members including Andrew Ogles, Joe Wilson, Tom Tiffany and Don Bacon \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/morrow_nw\/status\/1891571125253005794\u0022\u003Epenned a letter last week\u003C\/a\u003E, claiming the United States had been marginalised\u00a0 under the ANC, and if Pretoria did not act \u0026#8216;constructively\u0026#8217;, to rather pursue a path that includes suspension of diplomatic ties and removal of trade privileges, in addition to sanctions.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump recently signed a presidential order suspending aid to South Africa, and granting refugee status to its white minority Afrikaner community over\u00a0 the signing into law of a \u0026#8216;confiscation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; land reform bill. The new law opens the door to state seizure of private property in South Africa, in contravention of the constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPretoria\u0026#8217;s consistent undermining of US interests include \u0026#8220;the filing of a baseless claim\u0026#8221; before the International Court of Justice following the 7\/10 \u0026#8216;murder of 1 200 Jews including American citizens\u0026#8217;. The congressmen are upset that South Africa claims Israel wants to \u0026#8216;destroy the Palestinians\u0026#8217;, while it enjoys close ties to Hamas, allowing two \u0026#8220;Hamas-controlled charities\u0026#8221; the Al Aqsa Foundation and Al Quds Foundation to operate freely within our borders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;For decades, officials of the South African government have acted as Hamas propagandists, urging the international community to lift trade sanctions and otherwise engage with the US-designated foreign terrorist organisation.\u0026#8221; The Islamist group whose charter calls for the elimination of Israel and its replacement by a clerical dictatorship under a Pan-Arab constellation of states, is opposed to the secular rights and freedoms outlined by South Africa\u0026#8217;s own constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-02-18T06:23:38Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-02-18T06:28:18Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/02\/18\/republican-congress-seeks-sa-agoa-suspension-over-taiwan-hamas\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28580\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false},"actor":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2"}

The congressmen are upset that South Africa claims Israel wants to \u0026#8216;destroy the Palestinians\u0026#8217;, while it enjoys close ties to Hamas, allowing two \u0026#8220;Hamas-controlled charities\u0026#8221; the Al Aqsa Foundation and Al Quds Foundation to operate freely within our borders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;For decades, officials of the South African government have acted as Hamas propagandists, urging the international community to lift trade sanctions and otherwise engage with the US-designated foreign terrorist organisation.\u0026#8221; wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: MEMBERS of the US Congress have written to President Trump urging him to revoke South Africa’s AGOA preferential trade privileges. They cite the countries support of Harakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya (Hamas), and the attempted removal of the Taiwanese embassy in Pretoria, in addition to ‘destructive land reform policies’ and ‘consistent infidelity to the rule of law’, as violation of eligibility criteria for AGOA. Four congressional members including Andrew Ogles, Joe Wilson, Tom Tiffany and Don Bacon penned a letter last week, claiming the United States had been marginalised under the ANC, and if Pretoria did not act ‘constructively’, to rather pursue […]

The new law opens the door to state seizure of private property in South Africa, in contravention of the constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPretoria\u0026#8217;s consistent undermining of US interests such as \u0026#8220;the filing of a baseless claim\u0026#8221; before the International Court of Justice following the 7\/10 \u0026#8216;murder of 1 200 Jews including American citizens\u0026#8217;. wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: MEMBERS of the US Congress have written to President Trump urging him to revoke South Africa’s AGOA preferential trade privileges. They cite the countries support of Harakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya (Hamas), and the attempted removal of the Taiwanese embassy in Pretoria, in addition to ‘destructive land reform policies’ and ‘consistent infidelity to the rule of law’, as violation of eligibility criteria for AGOA. Four congressional members including Andrew Ogles, Joe Wilson, Tom Tiffany and Don Bacon penned a letter last week, claiming the United States had been marginalised under the ANC, and if Pretoria did not act ‘constructively’, to rather pursue […]

item.title: [Update] Note: Replacement theology at heart of…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/07\/replacement-theology-at-heart-of-middle-east-conflict\/","type":"Note","attachment":[],"attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. Proposals by the Palestine Solidarity Committee (PSC) for introduction of a bill which will \u0026#8216;domesticate\u0026#8217; the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.un.org\/en\/genocideprevention\/documents\/atrocity-crimes\/Doc.10_International%20Convention%20on%20the%20Suppression%20and%20Punishment%20of%20the%20Crime%20of%20Apartheid.pdf\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E1973 United Nations International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E, alongside the creation of \u0026#8216;apartheid-free zones\u0026#8217; and the criminalization of Zionism, confront us with an absurdity:\u003Cem\u003E it is as if apartheid never happened within South Africa\u003C\/em\u003E,\u003Cem\u003E since it appears no laws were adopted referencing the UN convention\u003C\/em\u003E?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf our 1994 dispensation appears in danger of being replaced by a formidable global campaign connected to a maximalist view of Palestinian territory, associated with the former British Colony, then you may be correct. \u0026#8220;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8221; is the oft heard rallying cry alongside \u0026#8220;Death to Israel and America\u0026#8221;, as anyone with a different viewpoint is shouted down. Yet the \u0026#8216;rainbow-coloured\u0026#8217; demonstrators have not translated into \u0026#8216;rainbow ideas\u0026#8217; in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is because replacement theology is at the heart of the conflict. A 2020 academic paper by Philip Du Toit on the question:\u003Ca href=\u0022http:\/\/www.scielo.org.za\/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext\u0026amp;pid=S2305-08532020000100007\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026#8216;Is Replacement Theology Anti-Semitic?\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026#8216;\u0026nbsp;begins by defining anti-Semitism as \u201c\u003Cem\u003Enormally understood as prejudice or hatred against Jewish people as a race\u201d\u003C\/em\u003E before concluding that since Christianity doesn\u2019t perceive the Jews as a race, Christian theology cannot, by definition be anti-Semitic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/brill.com\/display\/book\/edcoll\/9789004274761\/B9789004274761_014.xml\u0022\u003ERevisiting the Charge of Ta\u1e25r\u012bf: The Question of Supersessionism in Early Islam and the Qur\u02be\u0101n\u0026#8217; \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/em\u003ESandra Keiting argues that Islam was supersessionist from its inception, advocating the view that the \u0026#8216;Quranic revelations\u0026#8217; would \u0026#8220;replace the corrupted scriptures possessed by other communities\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.jns.org\/the-cornerstone-of-islamic-replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003EJonathon Feldstein \u003C\/a\u003Eobserves the popular \u0026#8216;Dome of the Rock\u0026#8217; in East Jerusalem has perhaps become \u0026#8220;the cornerstone of Islamic replacement theology\u0026#8221; alongside a new tradition that undermines both Judaism and Christianity. \u0026#8220;Today, it\u2019s commonplace to hear Palestinians and other Muslims deny any Jewish \u2014 and therefore Christian \u2014 history to the Temple Mount, Jerusalem and the Land of Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFeldstein\u0026#8217;s views are supported by a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/mkLs-yOi9gQ?si=ixQudHXxXB9oRJBY\u0022\u003Evideographer who prompted Arab Palestinians to explain the plethora of Jewish archeological sites in the region\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; A\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-isra\/104\u0022\u003El Israa 17.2-104\u003C\/a\u003E;Ta Ha 20.80; Al Mumim 40.53; Al Dukhan 44.32; Al Jathiya 45.16, all refer to Israel as the land of the Jews.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe absurdity of importing apartheid laws to South Africa\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest PSC dogma and its imported \u003Cem\u003Eweltanshauung\u003C\/em\u003E not only seeks to make Jews responsible for apartheid, it criminalises those who profess their religion on the basis of the biblical idea of Zion, in the process relocating South African history to the Middle East. \u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurthermore, it provides a canon that replaces the narrative of the Hebrews with that of Arab Palestinians, many of whom were migrants from across the former British and Ottoman Empires. One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u0026nbsp;domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREAD: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003EDebunked: Palestinians and Jews, each form a distinct race \u0026amp; the conflict is thus like apartheid,\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/apartheid\/\u0022\u003E#Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/gaza\/\u0022\u003E#Gaza\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/israel\/\u0022\u003E#Israel\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/palestine\/\u0022\u003E#Palestine\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003E#ReplacementTheology\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?post_type=ap_outbox\u0026p=28617","type":"Update","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","published":"2024-10-07T08:16:19Z","updated":"2025-02-23T07:50:00Z","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"sensitive":false,"object":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/07\/replacement-theology-at-heart-of-middle-east-conflict\/","type":"Note","attachment":[],"attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. Proposals by the Palestine Solidarity Committee (PSC) for introduction of a bill which will \u0026#8216;domesticate\u0026#8217; the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.un.org\/en\/genocideprevention\/documents\/atrocity-crimes\/Doc.10_International%20Convention%20on%20the%20Suppression%20and%20Punishment%20of%20the%20Crime%20of%20Apartheid.pdf\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E1973 United Nations International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E, alongside the creation of \u0026#8216;apartheid-free zones\u0026#8217; and the criminalization of Zionism, confront us with an absurdity:\u003Cem\u003E it is as if apartheid never happened within South Africa\u003C\/em\u003E,\u003Cem\u003E since it appears no laws were adopted referencing the UN convention\u003C\/em\u003E?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf our 1994 dispensation appears in danger of being replaced by a formidable global campaign connected to a maximalist view of Palestinian territory, associated with the former British Colony, then you may be correct. \u0026#8220;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8221; is the oft heard rallying cry alongside \u0026#8220;Death to Israel and America\u0026#8221;, as anyone with a different viewpoint is shouted down. Yet the \u0026#8216;rainbow-coloured\u0026#8217; demonstrators have not translated into \u0026#8216;rainbow ideas\u0026#8217; in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is because replacement theology is at the heart of the conflict. A 2020 academic paper by Philip Du Toit on the question:\u003Ca href=\u0022http:\/\/www.scielo.org.za\/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext\u0026amp;pid=S2305-08532020000100007\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026#8216;Is Replacement Theology Anti-Semitic?\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026#8216;\u0026nbsp;begins by defining anti-Semitism as \u201c\u003Cem\u003Enormally understood as prejudice or hatred against Jewish people as a race\u201d\u003C\/em\u003E before concluding that since Christianity doesn\u2019t perceive the Jews as a race, Christian theology cannot, by definition be anti-Semitic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/brill.com\/display\/book\/edcoll\/9789004274761\/B9789004274761_014.xml\u0022\u003ERevisiting the Charge of Ta\u1e25r\u012bf: The Question of Supersessionism in Early Islam and the Qur\u02be\u0101n\u0026#8217; \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/em\u003ESandra Keiting argues that Islam was supersessionist from its inception, advocating the view that the \u0026#8216;Quranic revelations\u0026#8217; would \u0026#8220;replace the corrupted scriptures possessed by other communities\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.jns.org\/the-cornerstone-of-islamic-replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003EJonathon Feldstein \u003C\/a\u003Eobserves the popular \u0026#8216;Dome of the Rock\u0026#8217; in East Jerusalem has perhaps become \u0026#8220;the cornerstone of Islamic replacement theology\u0026#8221; alongside a new tradition that undermines both Judaism and Christianity. \u0026#8220;Today, it\u2019s commonplace to hear Palestinians and other Muslims deny any Jewish \u2014 and therefore Christian \u2014 history to the Temple Mount, Jerusalem and the Land of Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFeldstein\u0026#8217;s views are supported by a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/mkLs-yOi9gQ?si=ixQudHXxXB9oRJBY\u0022\u003Evideographer who prompted Arab Palestinians to explain the plethora of Jewish archeological sites in the region\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u0026nbsp;domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREAD: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003EDebunked: Palestinians and Jews, each form a distinct race \u0026amp; the conflict is thus like apartheid,\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28635","type":"Note","attachment":[],"attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ENuclear Disarmament history joins Ukraine with South Africa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBOTH UKRAINE and South Africa share a history of nuclear disarmament. In fact we are the only two nations on Earth to willingly give up atomic weapons. Accusations that Pretoria is assisting Iran with nuclear capabilities are thus demonstrably false given this astonishing history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ES\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003Ehortly before the country transitioned to democracy, South Africa formally dismantled its weapons and production equipment, becoming the only country to voluntarily relinquish nuclear weapons after achieving the capability.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002217812930402698139034\u0022\u003EIn 1994, Ukraine, which had inherited a large Soviet nuclear arsenal after the USSR\u0026#8217;s collapse, agreed to relinquish its nuclear weapons and join the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) as a non-nuclear weapon state. It did this in exchange for security assurances from the US, UK, and Russia, an agreement formalized in the Budapest Memorandum\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003ESouth Africa is also a signatory to the NPT. In February 2019, South Africa ratified the \u003Ca title=\u0022Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Treaty_on_the_Prohibition_of_Nuclear_Weapons\u0022\u003ETreaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u003C\/a\u003E, becoming the first country to have had nuclear weapons, disarmed them and gone on to sign the treaty.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUkrainian President Zelenksy has been invited to this years G20 meeting by President Ramaphosa, it will provide ample opportunity for the parties to set the matter straight.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/iran\/\u0022\u003E#Iran\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/nuclear\/\u0022\u003E#Nuclear\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/ukraine\/\u0022\u003E#Ukraine\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ENuclear Disarmament history joins Ukraine with South Africa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBOTH UKRAINE and South Africa share a history of nuclear disarmament. In fact we are the only two nations on Earth to willingly give up atomic weapons. Accusations that Pretoria is assisting Iran with nuclear capabilities are thus demonstrably false given this astonishing history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ES\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003Ehortly before the country transitioned to democracy, South Africa formally dismantled its weapons and production equipment, becoming the only country to voluntarily relinquish nuclear weapons after achieving the capability.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002217812930402698139034\u0022\u003EIn 1994, Ukraine, which had inherited a large Soviet nuclear arsenal after the USSR\u0026#8217;s collapse, agreed to relinquish its nuclear weapons and join the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) as a non-nuclear weapon state. It did this in exchange for security assurances from the US, UK, and Russia, an agreement formalized in the Budapest Memorandum\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003ESouth Africa is also a signatory to the NPT. In February 2019, South Africa ratified the \u003Ca title=\u0022Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Treaty_on_the_Prohibition_of_Nuclear_Weapons\u0022\u003ETreaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u003C\/a\u003E, becoming the first country to have had Accusations that Pretoria is assisting Iran with nuclear capabilities are thus demonstrably false given this astonishing history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ES\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003Ehortly before the country transitioned to democracy, South Africa formally \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/South_Africa_and_weapons_of_mass_destruction#:~:text=South%20Africa%20ended%20its%20nuclear%20weapons%20programme,the%20Non%2DProliferation%20of%20Nuclear%20Weapons%20in%201991.\u0022\u003Edismantled its weapons and production equipment\u003C\/a\u003E, becoming the only country to voluntarily relinquish nuclear weapons after achieving the capability.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002217812930402698139034\u0022\u003EIn 1994, Ukraine, which had inherited a large Soviet nuclear arsenal after the USSR\u0026#8217;s collapse, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.armscontrol.org\/factsheets\/ukraine-nuclear-weapons-and-security-assurances-glance#:~:text=By%201996%2C%20Ukraine%20had%20returned%20all%20of,to%20the%201968%20nuclear%20Nonproliferation%20Treaty%20(NPT).\u0026amp;text=In%20response%2C%20Ukraine%20officially%20acceded%20to%20the,non%2Dnuclear%20weapon%20state%20on%20December%205%2C%201994.\u0022\u003Eagreed to relinquish its nuclear weapons and join the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons\u003C\/a\u003E (NPT) as a non-nuclear weapon state. It did this in exchange for security assurances from the US, UK, and Russia, an agreement formalized in the Budapest Memorandum\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003ESouth Africa is also a signatory to the NPT. In February 2019, South Africa ratified the \u003Ca title=\u0022Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Treaty_on_the_Prohibition_of_Nuclear_Weapons\u0022\u003ETreaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u003C\/a\u003E, becoming the first country to have had nuclear weapons, disarmed them and gone on to sign the treaty.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUkrainian President Zelenksy has been invited to this years G20 meeting by President Ramaphosa, it will provide ample opportunity for the parties to set the matter straight.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/iran\/\u0022\u003E#Iran\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/nuclear\/\u0022\u003E#Nuclear\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/ukraine\/\u0022\u003E#Ukraine\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ENuclear Disarmament: an historical link between Ukraine \u0026#038; South Africa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBOTH UKRAINE and South Africa share a history of nuclear disarmament. In fact we are the only two nations on Earth to willingly give up atomic weapons. Accusations that Pretoria is assisting Iran with nuclear capabilities are thus demonstrably false given this astonishing history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ES\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003Ehortly before the country transitioned to democracy, South Africa formally \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/South_Africa_and_weapons_of_mass_destruction#:~:text=South%20Africa%20ended%20its%20nuclear%20weapons%20programme,the%20Non%2DProliferation%20of%20Nuclear%20Weapons%20in%201991.\u0022\u003Edismantled its weapons and production equipment\u003C\/a\u003E, becoming the only country to voluntarily relinquish nuclear weapons after achieving the capability.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002217812930402698139034\u0022\u003EIn 1994, Ukraine, which had inherited a large Soviet nuclear arsenal after the USSR\u0026#8217;s collapse, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.armscontrol.org\/factsheets\/ukraine-nuclear-weapons-and-security-assurances-glance#:~:text=By%201996%2C%20Ukraine%20had%20returned%20all%20of,to%20the%201968%20nuclear%20Nonproliferation%20Treaty%20(NPT).\u0026amp;text=In%20response%2C%20Ukraine%20officially%20acceded%20to%20the,non%2Dnuclear%20weapon%20state%20on%20December%205%2C%201994.\u0022\u003Eagreed to relinquish its nuclear weapons and join the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons\u003C\/a\u003E (NPT) as a non-nuclear weapon state. It did this in exchange for security assurances from the US, UK, and Russia, an agreement formalized in the Budapest Memorandum\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002215356871210838217545\u0022\u003ESouth Africa is also a signatory to the NPT. In February 2019, South Africa ratified the \u003Ca title=\u0022Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons\u0022 item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28647","type":"Note","attachment":[],"attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ESA diplomatic shambles: Pollak v Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPRETORIA\u0026#8217;S foreign policy is in complete disarray following the\u003Cem\u003E demarche\u003C\/em\u003E of the Pro-Jihad Ambassador Ebrahim Rasool from Washington on Friday. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, Islamophobic, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last months controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal\u003C\/a\u003E, in which he doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa seems to suggest \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists are merely the Hague Group and Israel. Pollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South African foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps, but of course that would mean foregoing the ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes, and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullaah in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be efficable\u00a0 whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ESA diplomatic shambles: Pollak v Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPRETORIA\u0026#8217;S foreign policy is in complete disarray following the\u003Cem\u003E demarche\u003C\/em\u003E of the Pro-Jihad Ambassador Ebrahim Rasool from Washington on Friday. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, Islamophobic, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last months controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal\u003C\/a\u003E, in which he doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa seems to suggest \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists are merely the Hague Group and Israel. Pollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South African foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps, but of course that would mean foregoing the ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes, and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullaah in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be efficable\u00a0 whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

Rasool should know better than to label American citizens who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last months controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal\u003C\/a\u003E, in which he doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists are merely the Hague Group and Israel. Pollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South African foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps, but of course that would mean foregoing the ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes, and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be efficable\u00a0 whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T10:55:44Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

(\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), and since we all suffer in the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T11:03:29Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), and since we all suffer in the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T11:07:40Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel. South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for the millions being spent on ICJ litigation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T12:09:53Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}
