Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, Islamophobic, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for the millions being spent on ICJ litigation, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T12:13:15Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ESA diplomatic shambles: Pollak v Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPRETORIA\u0026#8217;S foreign policy is in complete disarray following the\u003Cem\u003E demarche\u003C\/em\u003E of the Pro-Jihad Ambassador Ebrahim Rasool from Washington on Friday. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, Islamophobic, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T12:15:30Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false}

Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to\u00a0 tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted coup in Jordan, to establish a Palestinian state in Jordan. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, Islamophobic, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to\u00a0 tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to\u00a0 tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. Jordan is Palestine on many pre-British maps.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-03-17T10:53:04Z","tag":[],"updated":"2025-03-17T12:20:57Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/03\/17\/sa-diplomatic-shambles-pollak-v-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28647\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"sensitive":false},"actor":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2"}

The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. Jordan is Palestine on many pre-British maps.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003ESA diplomatic shambles: Pollak v Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPRETORIA\u0026#8217;S foreign policy is in complete disarray following the\u003Cem\u003E demarche\u003C\/em\u003E of the Pro-Jihad Ambassador Ebrahim Rasool from Washington on Friday. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, \u0026#8216;Islamophobic\u0026#8217;, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to\u00a0 tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the women behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . The lessons of that reconciliation have been lost.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/businesstech.co.za\/news\/government\/816858\/south-africa-can-lose-its-united-states-consulate-in-johannesburg\/\u0022\u003ESouth Africa could lose its United States consulate in Johannesburg if the city changes the name of Sandton Drive to Leila Khaled Drive.\u003C\/a\u003E\u201d Note: Khalid is the terrorist behind a Black September 1970 plane hijacking which occurred during the attempted Black September coup in Jordan, to overthrow the monarchy and establish a Palestinian state. The expelling of the Islamist South African ambassador to the United States signals an unprecedented escalation of tensions between the two countries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot only is Rasool supportive of the Islamic movement to create a clerical dictatorship in the Middle East to replace Israel, (known as Hamas), he seems to have ignored the fact Trump gained office primarily due to the Latino vote. Labeling any opposition to Arab expansionism as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217; or \u0026#8216;supremacist\u0026#8217; or worse, \u0026#8216;Islamophobic\u0026#8217;, has become a routine slur against non-members of a faith practiced by 25% of the planet.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBe that as it may, neither nations nor religions are races. Rasool should know better than to label American citizens (and their leader) who want a closed Southern border to avoid drug cartels from Central America pursuing them, along with the associated decline in living standards as \u0026#8216;racist\u0026#8217;, and to rail against the Jeffersonian values of non-compulsion in religion.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile Rasool\u0026#8217;s race-baiting of Donald Trump was being taken to task by US secretary of State Marco Rubio, none of this has come as much of a surprise to those bothering to gain the perspective of both sides, and especially considering last month\u0026#8217;s controversial co-authoring by our President of an article by the so-called \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/foreignpolicy.com\/2025\/02\/25\/israel-war-crimes-trump-international-criminal-court\/\u0022\u003EHague Group in a Foreign Policy journal.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERamaphosa doubles-down on strange claims made in an October 2024 address in which he seems to believe \u003Cem\u003EIsrael was the one which attacked an outdoor peace festival in Gaza, taking hostages in the process\u003C\/em\u003E. (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/09\/president-ramaphosas-deplorable-7-10-address\/\u0022\u003EYou can read my response here\u003C\/a\u003E), since we all suffer from the UN-sponsored fiction that Gaza was occupied by Israel at the time, and thus Israel was somehow attacking Israel?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs a candidate US ambassador to South Africa Joel Pollak suggests, the article \u0026#8220;never once mentioned Hamas\u0026#8221; \u0026#8212; \u00a0 as if the protagonists here are merely the Hague Group versus Israel? South Africa has had to increase VAT to pay for \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/business\/2024-10-30-treasury-finds-r95-million-for-sas-genocide-case-against-israel\/\u0022\u003Ethe millions being spent on ICJ litigation\u003C\/a\u003E, while\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hudson.org\/security-alliances\/change-south-africas-behavior-target-anc-officials-joshua-meservey\u0022\u003E ANC officials face the prospect of US sanctions in addition to tariffs.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollak\u0026#8217;s analysis of what has gone wrong with South Africa\u0026#8217;s bizarre foreign policy should be required reading by our diplomatic corps \u0026#8212; but of course this would mean foregoing an ostrich mentality associated with previous regimes \u0026#8212; and a cancel culture which immediately labels any opinion not sanctioned by the Mullahs in Tehran as \u0026#8220;Zionist Witchcraft\u0026#8221; read \u0026#8220;Haraam\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.chaifm.com\/podcast\/2025-03-03-why-south-africa-seems-to-be-doubling-down-on-its-anti-us-stance-joel-barry-pollak-writer-and-political-commentator\/\u0022\u003EInterviewed on local Jewish-focused radio, ChaiFm\u003C\/a\u003E, Pollack who is a former South African, having married an anti-apartheid activist here, says: \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;If you take a look at the big picture, South Africa has basically cast its lot with these terrorists and the regimes which support them. You have to ask why? Because in the heyday of the Rainbow Nation under Mandela, there was an idea that South Africa could play a positive peacemaking role, export some of the lessons of compromise and reconciliation from the transition to democracy, and these could be applicable whether in Northern Ireland or the Middle East. \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003EThis has shifted over time to a SA which wants to be on the side of the \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221; as the Iranians call it. The people who are trying to undermine American leadership, and to destroy Israel, and to suppress Western Europe, and that is where SA sees itself. To get there you have to misread the history of the South African transition as if it were a military victory by the ANC where it crushed all before it, and basically decided in its magnanimity to tolerate the presence of other people in the country, when actually it was a hard-won compromise . item.title: [Update] Note: Anti-Semitism & its political adherents…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EAnti-Semitism \u0026#038; its political adherents in Parliament\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u200bTHERE is officially \u0026#8216;no antisemitism\u0026#8217; in South Africa. No sooner had Justice Minister Ronald Lamola kicked up a storm after making bizarre statements on a BBC hardtalk interview, the country was being entertained by two incidents from inside the country\u0026#8217;s various legislatures.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA tie-episode involving the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajr.co.za\/magen-david-tie-unlocks-antisemitism-in-joburg-council\/\u0022\u003Ewearing of a \u0026#8216;Star of David\u0026#8217; by a member of the Johannesburg City Council\u003C\/a\u003E was soon followed by threats inside the National House of Assembly: \u201cWe won\u2019t allow you make this a Jewish state. The City of Cape Town would be a bloodbath,\u201d ranted Member of Parliament Munzoor Shaik Emam, who proceeded to threaten Jews living in South Africa.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile\u0022\u003E\u003Cfigure class=\u0022wp-block-media-text__media\u0022\u003E\u003Cvideo src=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2024\/02\/ssstwitter.com_1708380468296.mp4\u0022 controls=\u0022controls\u0022 width=\u0022300\u0022 height=\u0022150\u0022\u003E\u003C\/video\u003E\u003C\/figure\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-media-text__content\u0022\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was Sartre who once remarked: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EIf the Jew did not exist, the Anti-Semite would invent him\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8221; In his seminal \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Anti-Semite_and_Jew\u0022\u003EAnti-Semite \u0026amp; Jew\u003C\/a\u003E, written after the author had noticed the absence of the Jews living in Paris before the war, deported to the Nazi death camps, he wrote: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EThe anti-Semite convinces himself of beliefs that he knows to be spurious at best.\u0026#8221; \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest debacle is redolent of ANC MP Marius Fransman\u0026#8217;s invention of \u0026#8216;Jewish property tycoons in Woodstock\u0026#8221;, and other \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sahrc.org.za\/index.php\/sahrc-media\/news\/item\/1577-sahrc-orders-marius-fransman-to-apologise-to-jewish-board-for-2013-remarks\u0022\u003Estatements for which he was ordered to apologise.\u003C\/a\u003E A suburb that had once seen an influx of Jews from the Shtetls of Czarist Russia, but which like District Six has lost its Jewish population, a factor of immigration and structural discrimination.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELamola\u0026#8217;s claim: \u0026#8220;There is no antisemitism in South Africa against the Jewish People\u201c is not only a blatant lie, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/documents\/antisemitism-in-sa-increased-by-631--sajbd\u0022\u003Esimilarly debunked\u003C\/a\u003E, with a demonstrable increase of 631% over the past three months, but it reminds one of equally perverse statements made by the likes of Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, who once proclaimed: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.editionpatrickfrey.com\/en\/books\/there-are-no-homosexuals-iran\u0022\u003E\u201cIn Iran, we do not have homosexuals\u003C\/a\u003E. Or apartheid\u0026#8217;s own PW Botha who explained to the world\u0026#8217;s press:\u0026#8221;Most Blacks are happy\u0026#8221; and \u0026#8220;we treat our Blacks well.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESartre explained the tendency towards the objectification of Jews, who before the creation of the state of Israel, had become the \u0026#8216;objects of history\u0026#8217; instead of the \u0026#8216;subjects of humans rights\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;A Jew is a person that others look at and say, \u0026#8220;look, he\/she is a Jew\u0026#8221;. Just as a chair is a chair by virtue of our considering it a chair, so is a Jew a person whom others consider to be a Jew. Therefore, a Jew\u0026#8217;s Jewishness exists only to the extent they are considered Jewish by those around them.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 2010 hearing presided over by ANC apparatchik Halton Cheadle involving his own client, found \u003Cem\u003Einter alia\u003C\/em\u003E, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/01\/12\/most-of-all-i-am-offended-as-a-secularist\u0022\u003Ethat since apparently I am a \u0026#8220;Jew in breach of my religion\u0026#8221; or simply not Jewish enough, I can\u0026#8217;t claim antisemitism \u00a0\u003C\/a\u003Eon the basis of an outrageous inquiry into my identity by an apartheid media firm \u0026#8212; an entity that pathetically denied their role in the regime, and proceeded to pillory the findings of the TRC during the kangaroo \u0026#8216;trial\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESo yes Minister Lamola, there is \u0026#8216;Anti-Semitism\u0026#8217; or Jew-hatred in my country \u0026#8212; a disgraceful, ugly history harking all the way back to the dark days of the National Party, whose swastikas adorned membership cards, whose laws actively discriminated on the basis of religion and cultural identity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-group\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained\u0022\u003E\u003Cins class=\u0022adsbygoogle\u0022style=\u0022display:block; its political adherents in Parliament\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u200bTHERE is officially \u0026#8216;no antisemitism\u0026#8217; in South Africa. No sooner had Justice Minister Ronald Lamola kicked up a storm after making bizarre statements on a BBC hardtalk interview, the country was being entertained by two incidents from inside the country\u0026#8217;s various legislatures.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA tie-episode involving the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajr.co.za\/magen-david-tie-unlocks-antisemitism-in-joburg-council\/\u0022\u003Ewearing of a \u0026#8216;Star of David\u0026#8217; by a member of the Johannesburg City Council\u003C\/a\u003E was soon followed by threats inside the National House of Assembly: \u201cWe won\u2019t allow you make this a Jewish state. The City of Cape Town would be a bloodbath,\u201d ranted Member of Parliament Munzoor Shaik Emam, who proceeded to threaten Jews living in South Africa.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-media-text is-stacked-on-mobile\u0022\u003E\u003Cfigure class=\u0022wp-block-media-text__media\u0022\u003E\u003Cvideo src=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2024\/02\/ssstwitter.com_1708380468296.mp4\u0022 controls=\u0022controls\u0022 width=\u0022300\u0022 height=\u0022150\u0022\u003E\u003C\/video\u003E\u003C\/figure\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-media-text__content\u0022\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was Sartre who once remarked: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EIf the Jew did not exist, the Anti-Semite would invent him\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8221; In his seminal \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Anti-Semite_and_Jew\u0022\u003EAnti-Semite \u0026amp; Jew\u003C\/a\u003E, written after the author had noticed the absence of the Jews living in Paris before the war, deported to the Nazi death camps, he wrote: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EThe anti-Semite convinces himself of beliefs that he knows to be spurious at best.\u0026#8221; \u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest debacle is redolent of ANC MP Marius Fransman\u0026#8217;s invention of \u0026#8216;Jewish property tycoons in Woodstock\u0026#8221;, and other \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sahrc.org.za\/index.php\/sahrc-media\/news\/item\/1577-sahrc-orders-marius-fransman-to-apologise-to-jewish-board-for-2013-remarks\u0022\u003Estatements for which he was ordered to apologise.\u003C\/a\u003E A suburb that had once seen an influx of Jews from the Shtetls of Czarist Russia, but which like District Six has lost its Jewish population, a factor of immigration and structural discrimination.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELamola\u0026#8217;s claim: \u0026#8220;There is no antisemitism in South Africa against the Jewish People\u201c is not only a blatant lie, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/documents\/antisemitism-in-sa-increased-by-631--sajbd\u0022\u003Esimilarly debunked\u003C\/a\u003E, with a demonstrable increase of 631% over the past three months, but it reminds one of equally perverse statements made by the likes of Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, who once proclaimed: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.editionpatrickfrey.com\/en\/books\/there-are-no-homosexuals-iran\u0022\u003E\u201cIn Iran, we do not have homosexuals\u003C\/a\u003E. Or apartheid\u0026#8217;s own PW Botha who explained to the world\u0026#8217;s press:\u0026#8221;Most Blacks are happy\u0026#8221; and \u0026#8220;we treat our Blacks well.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESartre explained the tendency towards the objectification of Jews, who before the creation of the state of Israel, had become the \u0026#8216;objects of history\u0026#8217; instead of the \u0026#8216;subjects of humans rights\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;A Jew is a person that others look at and say, \u0026#8220;look, he\/she is a Jew\u0026#8221;. Just as a chair is a chair by virtue of our considering it a chair, so is a Jew a person whom others consider to be a Jew. Therefore, a Jew\u0026#8217;s Jewishness exists only to the extent they are considered Jewish by those around them.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 2010 hearing presided over by ANC apparatchik Halton Cheadle involving his own client, found \u003Cem\u003Einter alia\u003C\/em\u003E, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/01\/12\/most-of-all-i-am-offended-as-a-secularist\u0022\u003Ethat since apparently I am a \u0026#8220;Jew in breach of my religion\u0026#8221; or simply not Jewish enough, I can\u0026#8217;t claim antisemitism \u00a0\u003C\/a\u003Eon the basis of an outrageous inquiry into my identity by an apartheid media firm \u0026#8212; an entity that pathetically denied their role in the regime, and proceeded to pillory the findings of the TRC during the kangaroo \u0026#8216;trial\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESo yes Minister Lamola, there is \u0026#8216;Anti-Semitism\u0026#8217; or Jew-hatred in my country \u0026#8212; a disgraceful, ugly history harking all the way back to the dark days of the National Party, whose swastikas adorned membership cards, whose laws actively discriminated on the basis of religion and cultural identity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022wp-block-group\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv item.title: [Create] Note: Dear Ebrahim RasoolDear Ebrahim Rasool,YOUR…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28695","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the inaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;save the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217; and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 Earth Rights of our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of Simchat Torah, and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner Vow at Blood River \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; (see here) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind \u00a0 it is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the contribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning.\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner Vow at Blood River \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; (see here) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind \u00a0 it is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the contribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning.\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}},"actor":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2"}

Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the contribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning.\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the inaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;save the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217; and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 Earth Rights in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of Simchat Torah, and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner Vow at Blood River \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; (see here) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind \u00a0 it is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the contribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive
