item.title: [Update] Note: Dear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28695","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the inaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;save the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217; and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 Earth Rights in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the contribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning.\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous Minister of Justice Ronald Lamola claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0 and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning.\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T19:58:37Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionsts and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question your\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;, \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:06:50Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28695","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the inaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;save the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217; and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 Earth Rights in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;,\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;,\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism or national boundaries.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission, and were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:11:17Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;,\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries per se.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the St James Church Massacre did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to deport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;,\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries per se.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv id=\u0022transcriptElement-114\u0022 class=\u0022TranscriptElement-sc-1235qb-18 hOZcCQ\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022TranscriptText-sc-1235qb-20 bzsqPS\u0022\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:16:59Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28695","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the inaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;save the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217; and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 Earth Rights in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;,\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries per se.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries per se.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:21:27Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries per se.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 strangely claimed is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 bizarrely claims is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as you appear to, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:25:27Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}
