were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 bizarrely claims is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as your wearing of an Iraqi Keffiyah signed by Haniyeh suggests, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2016\/09\/22\/environmental-activism-during-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Einaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC\u003C\/a\u003E, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003Esave the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 \u0026#8216;Earth Rights\u0026#8217; in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against apartheid, a system based upon race segregation not religious schism nor national boundaries \u003Cem\u003Eper se.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Faith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u0026#8221;\u00a0\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003E Pollack explained on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u0026#8220;Axis of Resistance\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as your wearing of an Iraqi Keffiyah signed by Haniyeh suggests, are surely\u00a0 living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u0026#8217;t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u0026#8217;ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-10T20:29:50Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28695","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2016\/09\/22\/environmental-activism-during-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Einaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC\u003C\/a\u003E, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003Esave the seed, and save the soil\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 \u0026#8216;Earth Rights\u0026#8217; in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u0026#8217;\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which including the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons who attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u0026#8212; were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u0026#8220;Intifada\u0026#8221;\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; a self-styled Jihad to \u0026#8220;liberate Quds and Al Aksa\u0026#8221;, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u0026#8212;\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u0026#8216;Vow at Blood River\u0026#8217; \u0026#8212; which some may view as a parallel to \u0026#8220;God\u0026#8217;s apartheid\u0026#8221; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u0026#8212; which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against a system based upon race segregation, not religious schism nor national boundaries \u003Cem\u003Eper se.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u0026#8217;s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War,\u00a0 or what you claim is simply \u0026#8216;Islamic resistance to Zionism\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u0026#8220;from the River to the Sea\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their\u00a0 vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country whose previous \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister of Justice Ronald Lamola\u00a0 bizarrely claims is wholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E and where successive affronts against Jewish communities\u00a0 have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000 to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister Ronald Lamola \u003C\/a\u003Eand where successive affronts against Jewish communities have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000+ to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans on this count, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u201cFaith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u201d\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003Eexplained \u003C\/a\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003EPollack on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u201cAxis of Resistance\u201d.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as your wearing of an Iraqi-designed Keffiyah (appropriated by the Palestinian movement) and signed by Haniyeh suggests, are surely living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u2019t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u2019ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool, open letter to former SA ambassador to USA\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDear Ebrahim Rasool,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EYOUR CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GLOBAL INTIFADA, CLERICAL DICTATORSHIP \u0026amp; JIHAD REFERS\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022gmail_default\u0022\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022entry-content\u0022\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWe first met at Community House back in the 1980s, where your organisation, World Council on Religion and Peace (WCRP) had its offices. Subsequently you became involved in environmental justice as a co-sponsor alongside Cape Town Ecology Group (CTEG) of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2016\/09\/22\/environmental-activism-during-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Einaugural 1991 Environment and Development Conference at UWC\u003C\/a\u003E, where Farid Esack, Cheryl Carolus, the late Sandile Dikeni and myself were on the same anti-apartheid platform that aligned with the objectives of the Freedom Charter to \u2018\u003Cem\u003Esave the seed, and save the soil\u2019\u003C\/em\u003E and which resulted in the inclusion of ecological sustainable development under article 24 \u2018Earth Rights\u2019 in our Constitution.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOver a year ago, I watched in horror, as images of the Hamas-lead \u2018\u003Cem\u003EOperation Al-Aqsa Flood\u2019\u003C\/em\u003E in which jihadists live-streamed their attacks on Israeli citizens during the Jewish holiday of \u003Cem\u003ESimchat Torah,\u003C\/em\u003E and on the 50th Anniversary of the Yom Kippur War, were streamed onto social media. These appalling events which included the slaying of two Kenyan students, the cold-blooded slaughter of disabled persons such as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.i24news.tv\/en\/news\/israel-at-war\/1697707685-he-took-his-disabled-daughter-to-the-raves-that-gave-her-life-hamas-murdered-both\u0022\u003Ewheelchair bound Ruth Peretz \u003C\/a\u003Ewho attended an outdoor Music festival and the taking of female hostages, many of whom appeared to have bloody buttocks \u2014 were soon followed by equally appalling video of the Israel counter-assault on Gaza.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI am not writing this letter to take issue with your controversial webinar statements about the current President of the United States, but rather to question y\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.politicsweb.co.za\/opinion\/rasool-is-no-hero\u0022\u003Eour\u00a0 divergence from the path of peace and non-violence, to embrace a violent global \u201cIntifada\u201d\u003C\/a\u003E \u2014 a self-styled Jihad to \u201cliberate Quds and Al Aksa\u201d, by any means necessary, and on behalf of a clerical dictatorship which has resulted in a modern inquisition of Jewish identity on the campuses of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is very far from advocacy of a secular solution to a religious disagreement at the heart of the problematic of apartheid \u2014\u00a0 the much-vaunted Afrikaner \u2018Vow at Blood River\u2019 \u2014 which some may view as a parallel to \u201cGod\u2019s apartheid\u201d \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/09\/20\/masilo-lepuru-todays-bigots-and-their-latest-obsessions-with-race-and-god\/\u0022\u003E(see here\u003C\/a\u003E) \u2014 which you most certainly opposed and rallied against during the struggle against a system based upon race segregation, not religious schism nor national boundaries \u003Cem\u003Eper se.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EResistance by any means necessary and come what may, whatever the death toll, is surely the path of bloody mayhem leaving everyone in the world blind.\u00a0 It is most certainly inconsistent with our country\u2019s pacifist constitution which prohibits propaganda for war. Religious zealotry of such order, would have been regarded as anathema during our own struggle. I therefore wish to challenge your uncritical embrace of Holy War, or what you claim is simply \u2018Islamic resistance to Zionism\u2019,\u00a0 a religious vendetta in which Hamas with its Death charter sets out a basis for an Arab state within a constellation of Arab states, to replace Israel, \u201cfrom the River to the Sea\u201d.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHave you forgotten how similar ideologies in our country panned out? Those who rendered their vengeance on all and sundry during the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/Saint_James_Church_massacre\u0022\u003E 1993 St James Church Massacre\u003C\/a\u003E did not receive amnesty at the Truth \u0026amp; Reconciliation Commission. They were considered very much in the same league as Botha, Malan and Vorster who saw fit to \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajbd.org\/media\/the-loud-mouth-rabbi-who-was-told-to-go\u0022\u003Edeport Jews such as Rabbi Andrew Ungar\u003C\/a\u003E from our country, so easily stripping citizenship from those not deemed European enough, and thus incarcerating Zionists and Non-Zionists alike alongside Nelson Mandela at the Rivonia trial.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI need not relate the fate of the Jews of District Six or the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2013\/12\/23\/arthur-goldreich-fingered-as-key-zionist-operative-in-mandela-trial\/\u0022\u003Econtribution of Zionists such as Arthur Goldreich\u003C\/a\u003E, to bemoan the fact that I live in a country \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003Ewholly absent of Antisemitism,\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E according to bizarre denials issued by \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/02\/21\/anti-semitism-its-local-adherents\/\u0022\u003EMinister Ronald Lamola \u003C\/a\u003Eand where successive affronts against Jewish of falling in line with the so-called \u201cAxis of Resistance\u201d.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as your wearing of an Iraqi-designed Keffiyah communities have resulted in a situation in which the Jews of South Africa are a vulnerable minority, having reduced in size from some 100 000+ to barely 40 000 in little over two decades.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo see our country taking a lead in pursuing a vendetta on the basis of religion, in which critics such as Joel Pollack are moved to challenge South Africans on this count, is a disgrace.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u201cFaith used in this way and abused is a throwback to the Medieval Era when the Inquisition would pursue Jews on the basis of these selective readings or misinterpretations of the Jewish faith and to watch South Africa do [this at the ICJ by misquoting the Hebrew Bible as evidence of genocide] was really stomach turning\u201d\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003Eexplained \u003C\/a\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/Yv0TlhfwxW\u0022\u003EPollack on a recent Daily Maverick podcast.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPollack believes the country should rather take a more productive approach by exporting our peaceful negotiated outcome as a model to emulate instead of falling in line with the so-called \u201cAxis of Resistance\u201d.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThose who believe in a military solution to the conflict as your wearing of an Iraqi-designed Keffiyah (appropriated by the Palestinian movement) and signed by Haniyeh suggests, are surely living in cloud-cuckooland? As Mother Teresa of Calcutta put it: \u201cI was once asked why I don\u2019t participate in anti-war demonstrations. I said that I will never do that, but as soon as you have a pro-peace rally, I\u2019ll be there.\u201d\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESincerely yours,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDavid Robert Lewis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-04-10T19:44:17Z","updated":"2025-04-30T10:59:19Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28695\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.title: [Create] Note: Gaza: Step back from the…

item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28766","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EGaza: Step back from the brink before it is too late Mr Ramaphosa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFOR DECADES South Africa\u0026#8217;s ruling ANC has clung to the notion that solidarity with the Palestinian cause translates into influencing of events on the ground. Yet the upshot of expelling the Israeli ambassador following the atrocity of 7\/10\/23,\u00a0 appears to be an ingress into the conflict arena, a tit-for-tat expelling of Ebrahim Rasool from Washington.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOur ICJ case has emboldening Republicans to call for sanctions and boycotts against our country (just some of the many consequences of taking sides) leading SA Jewish Report\u0026#8217;s Howard Sackstein to write, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajr.co.za\/cyril-was-it-worth-it\/\u0022\u003ECyril was it worth it?\u003C\/a\u003E Worse South African lawfare has turned into a political circus \u0026#8212; with a veritable line-up of dictators, rogues and\u00a0 monarchs in the region, diluting what may be said to comprise our nation\u0026#8217;s democratic appeal and moral claim before the court.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf like Swaziland and the Saudis, we condone absolute monarchy, we are not promoting the secular frame of our democratic constitution, with its emphasis on human rights, equality, religious freedom and protection of minorities within the general body politic, what exactly are we promoting other than sheer blindness to \u0026#8216;rule of law\u0026#8217;?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere the late Nelson Mandela was decidedly bipartisan on the issue, promoting a two-state solution that would allow both sides to coexist, successive ANC administrations have gradually adopted the maximalist view, consistent with those like \u0026#8216;Islamic Jihad for Palestine\u0026#8217; who wish to eliminate Israel, to remove the Jews from the Middle East. All of which begs the question, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2021\/11\/18\/what-if-israel-didnt-exist-isacowitz-vs-shain\/\u0022\u003Ewhere would half of all the Jews living in the world go,\u003C\/a\u003E if they were removed under objectives outlined by Hamas, or promoted by Fatah with its \u0026#8216;pay-for-slay\u0026#8217; programe?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBarrister Natasha Hausdorff of \u0026#8216;UK Lawyers for Israel\u0026#8217; asserts South Africa\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=6wrhzDBvhEc\u0022\u003Eclaims of genocide, occupation and apartheid\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 are a canard, an \u0026#8216;untrue blood libel without basis in international law\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/a\u003E In the instance of our ICJ case, our claim, she says, is a merely a legal hook on which to draw Israel before the court, since Israel is a signatory to the Genocide Convention, which came about because of the Holocaust. In addition the legal definition she says, requires intention to commit genocide, an element that she claims is entirely missing given the sequence of events following 7\/10.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsent the Hamas-led, live-streamed slaughter of Israelis on that tragic day, which included disabled victims considered too much trouble to hold hostage, or the cold-blooded slaying of black Kenyan students, and one might well believe Israel has a genocidal motive in the conflict. The resulting war has been particularly devastating for the population of Gaza given Hamas refusal to provide shelter and aid for its citizens. Instead of bomb shelters we have seen tunnels with munitions, secondary explosions, as Israel plays \u003Cem\u003Ewackamole\u003C\/em\u003E, in one of the densest urban environments, this whilst the Islamic group is accused of denying access to food aid transferred during the ceasefire period.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAccording to Hausdorff\u0026#8217;s evidence before the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/J6GoUJj4Fk\u0022\u003EUK House of Commons Foreign Affairs committee\u003C\/a\u003E, last week, the UN famine review committee found claims of famine by the IPC implausible considering the amount of aid which has entered Gaza. She points to calorific content exceeding NHS guidelines and the sheer weight of aid delivered during the recent ceasefire, amounting to several months of food for each and every Gazan. Instead she fingers Hamas\u0026#8217;s active diversion of aid, as one of the tactics used to blame Israel in a psychological war that has deployed martyrdom as a tactic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile pro-Israel attorneys such as Hausdorff are quick to promote the idea of a \u0026#8216;moral army fighting terrorism\u0026#8217;, with one of the \u0026#8216;lowest combatant to civilian kill ratios of any conflict in the world\u0026#8217;, the mounting death-toll and prospect of starvation of the general population caused by the Jihadist logic behind the conflict, puts paid to the notion that anyone can simply, step back from actively promoting a cessation to hostilities on both sides.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EParticularly appalling is the manner in which South Africa has repeated the mistakes of its near distant past. Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to the Final Solution, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior under Smuts government DF Malan\u0026#8217; who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Hitler\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Arab states, many of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure. All of which begs the question, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2021\/11\/18\/what-if-israel-didnt-exist-isacowitz-vs-shain\/\u0022\u003Ewhere would half of all the Jews living in the world go,\u003C\/a\u003E if they were removed under objectives outlined by Hamas, or promoted by Fatah with its \u0026#8216;pay-for-slay\u0026#8217; programe?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBarrister Natasha Hausdorff of \u0026#8216;UK Lawyers for Israel\u0026#8217; asserts South Africa\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=6wrhzDBvhEc\u0022\u003Eclaims of genocide, occupation and apartheid\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 are a canard, an \u0026#8216;untrue blood libel without basis in international law\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/a\u003E In the instance of our ICJ case, our claim, she says, is a merely a legal hook on which to draw Israel before the court, since Israel is a signatory to the Genocide Convention, which came about because of the Holocaust. In addition the legal definition she says, requires intention to commit genocide, an element that she claims is entirely missing given the sequence of events following 7\/10.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsent the Hamas-led, live-streamed slaughter of Israelis on that tragic day, which included disabled victims considered too much trouble to hold hostage, or the cold-blooded slaying of black Kenyan students, and one might well believe Israel has a genocidal motive in the conflict. The resulting war has been particularly devastating for the population of Gaza given Hamas refusal to provide shelter and aid for its citizens. Instead of bomb shelters we have seen tunnels with munitions, secondary explosions, as Israel plays \u003Cem\u003Ewackamole\u003C\/em\u003E, in one of the densest urban environments, this whilst the Islamic group is accused of denying access to food aid transferred during the ceasefire period.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAccording to Hausdorff\u0026#8217;s evidence before the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/J6GoUJj4Fk\u0022\u003EUK House of Commons Foreign Affairs committee\u003C\/a\u003E, last week, the UN famine review committee found claims of famine by the IPC implausible considering the amount of aid which has entered Gaza. She points to calorific content exceeding NHS guidelines and the sheer weight of aid delivered during the recent ceasefire, amounting to several months of food for each and every Gazan. Instead she fingers Hamas\u0026#8217;s active diversion of aid, as one of the tactics used to blame Israel in a psychological war that has deployed martyrdom as a tactic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile pro-Israel attorneys such as Hausdorff are quick to promote the idea of a \u0026#8216;moral army fighting terrorism\u0026#8217;, with one of the \u0026#8216;lowest combatant to civilian kill ratios of any conflict in the world\u0026#8217;, the mounting death-toll and prospect of starvation of the general population caused by the Jihadist logic behind the conflict, puts paid to the notion that anyone can simply, step back from actively promoting a cessation to hostilities on both sides.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EParticularly appalling is the manner in which South Africa has repeated the mistakes of its near distant past. Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to the Final Solution, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior under Smuts government DF Malan\u0026#8217; who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Hitler\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Arab states, many of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure. We may yet live to regret it, having repeated the mistakes of our nations\u0026#8217; past in not considering peaceful alternatives.\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-05-05T10:43:18Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/05\/gaza-step-back-from-the-brink-before-it-is-too-late-mr-ramaphosa\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}},"actor":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2"}

Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to the Hitler\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Final Solution\u0026#8217;, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior under Smuts government DF Malan\u0026#8217; who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Germany\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by IDF artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Middle East states, some of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back our allies from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure. In addition the legal definition she says, requires intention to commit genocide, an element that she avers is entirely missing given the sequence of events following 7\/10.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsent the Hamas-led, live-streamed slaughter of Israelis on that tragic day, which included disabled victims considered too much trouble to hold hostage, or the cold-blooded slaying of black Kenyan students, one may well be mislead into believing Israel has a genocidal motive in the conflict. The resulting war has been particularly devastating for the population of Gaza given Hamas refusal to provide shelter and aid for its citizens. Instead of bomb shelters we have seen tunnels with munitions, secondary explosions, as Israel plays \u003Cem\u003Ewackamole\u003C\/em\u003E, in one of the densest urban environments, this whilst the Islamic group is accused of denying access to food aid transferred during the ceasefire period.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAccording to Hausdorff\u0026#8217;s evidence before the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/J6GoUJj4Fk\u0022\u003EUK House of Commons Foreign Affairs committee\u003C\/a\u003E, last week, the UN famine review committee found claims of famine by the IPC implausible considering the amount of aid which has entered Gaza. She points to calorific content exceeding NHS guidelines and the sheer weight of aid delivered during the recent ceasefire, amounting to several months of food for each and every Gazan. Instead she fingers Hamas\u0026#8217;s active diversion of aid, as one of the tactics used to blame Israel in a psychological war that has deployed martyrdom as a tactic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile pro-Israel attorneys such as Hausdorff are quick to promote the idea of a \u0026#8216;moral army fighting terrorism\u0026#8217;, with one of the \u0026#8216;lowest combatant to civilian kill ratios of any conflict in the world\u0026#8217;, the mounting death-toll and prospect of starvation of the general population caused by the Jihadist logic behind the conflict, puts paid to the notion that anyone can simply, step back from actively promoting a cessation to hostilities on both sides.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EParticularly appalling is the manner in which South Africa has repeated the mistakes of its near distant past. Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to Hitler\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Final Solution\u0026#8217;, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior under the Smuts government DF Malan, who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Germany\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by IDF artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Middle East states, some of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the wholesale sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back our allies from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure. We may yet live to regret it, having repeated the mistakes of our nations\u0026#8217; past in not considering peaceful alternatives\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-05-05T10:43:18Z","updated":"2025-05-06T06:32:57Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/05\/gaza-step-back-from-the-brink-before-it-is-too-late-mr-ramaphosa\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.title: [Update] Note: Replacement theology at heart of…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/07\/replacement-theology-at-heart-of-middle-east-conflict\/","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. Proposals by the Palestine Solidarity Committee (PSC) for introduction of a bill which will \u0026#8216;domesticate\u0026#8217; the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.un.org\/en\/genocideprevention\/documents\/atrocity-crimes\/Doc.10_International%20Convention%20on%20the%20Suppression%20and%20Punishment%20of%20the%20Crime%20of%20Apartheid.pdf\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E1973 United Nations International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E, alongside the creation of \u0026#8216;apartheid-free zones\u0026#8217; and the criminalization of Zionism, confront us with an absurdity:\u003Cem\u003E it is as if apartheid never happened within South Africa\u003C\/em\u003E,\u003Cem\u003E since it appears no laws were adopted referencing the UN convention\u003C\/em\u003E?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf our 1994 dispensation appears in danger of being replaced by a formidable global campaign connected to a maximalist view of Palestinian territory, associated with the former British Colony, then you may be correct. \u0026#8220;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8221; is the oft heard rallying cry alongside \u0026#8220;Death to Israel and America\u0026#8221;, as anyone with a different viewpoint is shouted down. Yet the \u0026#8216;rainbow-coloured\u0026#8217; demonstrators have not translated into \u0026#8216;rainbow ideas\u0026#8217; in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is because replacement theology is at the heart of the conflict. A 2020 academic paper by Philip Du Toit on the question:\u003Ca href=\u0022http:\/\/www.scielo.org.za\/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext\u0026amp;pid=S2305-08532020000100007\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E\u00a0\u0026#8216;Is Replacement Theology Anti-Semitic?\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026#8216;\u00a0begins by defining anti-Semitism as \u201c\u003Cem\u003Enormally understood as prejudice or hatred against Jewish people as a race\u201d\u003C\/em\u003E before concluding that since Christianity doesn\u2019t perceive the Jews as a race, Christian theology cannot, by definition be anti-Semitic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/brill.com\/display\/book\/edcoll\/9789004274761\/B9789004274761_014.xml\u0022\u003ERevisiting the Charge of Ta\u1e25r\u012bf: The Question of Supersessionism in Early Islam and the Qur\u02be\u0101n\u0026#8217; \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/em\u003ESandra Keiting argues that Islam was supersessionist from its inception, advocating the view that the \u0026#8216;Quranic revelations\u0026#8217; would \u0026#8220;replace the corrupted scriptures possessed by other communities\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.jns.org\/the-cornerstone-of-islamic-replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003EJonathon Feldstein \u003C\/a\u003Eobserves the popular \u0026#8216;Dome of the Rock\u0026#8217; in East Jerusalem has perhaps become \u0026#8220;the cornerstone of Islamic replacement theology\u0026#8221; alongside a new tradition that undermines both Judaism and Christianity. \u0026#8220;Today, it\u2019s commonplace to hear Palestinians and other Muslims deny any Jewish \u2014 and therefore Christian \u2014 history to the Temple Mount, Jerusalem and the Land of Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFeldstein\u0026#8217;s views are supported by a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/mkLs-yOi9gQ?si=ixQudHXxXB9oRJBY\u0022\u003Evideographer who prompted Arab Palestinians to explain the plethora of Jewish archeological sites in the region\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; A\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-isra\/104\u0022\u003El Israa 17.2-104\u003C\/a\u003E;Ta Ha 20.80; Al Mumim 40.53; Al Dukhan 44.32; Al Jathiya 45.16, all refer to Israel as the land of the Jews.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe absurdity of importing apartheid laws to South Africa\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest PSC dogma and its imported \u003Cem\u003Eweltanshauung\u003C\/em\u003E not only seeks to make Jews responsible for apartheid, it criminalises those who profess their religion on the basis of the biblical idea of Zion, in the process relocating South African history to the Middle East.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurthermore, it provides a canon that replaces the narrative of the Hebrews with that of Arab Palestinians, many of whom were migrants from across the former British and Ottoman Empires. One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 1936 economic review in the Damascus newspaper \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EAl Ayam\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E corroborates by complaining. \u003Cem\u003E\u201cWhole villages in the Hauran have been emptied of their people, who are drifting into [Mandate] Palestine. Count De Martel, French High Commissioner for Syria, asserted in the summer of 1934 that even Arab merchants were moving from Damascus to [Mandate] Palestine because of the [Jewish created] prosperity there.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u00a0domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u00a0\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREAD: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003EDebunked: Palestinians and Jews, each form a distinct race \u0026amp; the conflict is thus like apartheid,\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/apartheid\/\u0022\u003E#Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/gaza\/\u0022\u003E#Gaza\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/israel\/\u0022\u003E#Israel\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/palestine\/\u0022\u003E#Palestine\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003E#ReplacementTheology\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/27832\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. item.title: [Update] Note: Replacement theology at heart of…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/07\/replacement-theology-at-heart-of-middle-east-conflict\/","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. Proposals by the Palestine Solidarity Committee (PSC) for introduction of a bill which will \u0026#8216;domesticate\u0026#8217; the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.un.org\/en\/genocideprevention\/documents\/atrocity-crimes\/Doc.10_International%20Convention%20on%20the%20Suppression%20and%20Punishment%20of%20the%20Crime%20of%20Apartheid.pdf\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E1973 United Nations International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E, alongside the creation of \u0026#8216;apartheid-free zones\u0026#8217; and the criminalization of Zionism, confront us with an absurdity:\u003Cem\u003E it is as if apartheid never happened within South Africa\u003C\/em\u003E,\u003Cem\u003E since it appears no laws were adopted referencing the UN convention\u003C\/em\u003E?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf our 1994 dispensation appears in danger of being replaced by a formidable global campaign connected to a maximalist view of Palestinian territory, associated with the former British Colony, then you may be correct. \u0026#8220;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8221; is the oft heard rallying cry alongside \u0026#8220;Death to Israel and America\u0026#8221;, as anyone with a different viewpoint is shouted down. Yet the \u0026#8216;rainbow-coloured\u0026#8217; demonstrators have not translated into \u0026#8216;rainbow ideas\u0026#8217; in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is because replacement theology is at the heart of the conflict. A 2020 academic paper by Philip Du Toit on the question:\u003Ca href=\u0022http:\/\/www.scielo.org.za\/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext\u0026amp;pid=S2305-08532020000100007\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E\u00a0\u0026#8216;Is Replacement Theology Anti-Semitic?\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026#8216;\u00a0begins by defining anti-Semitism as \u201c\u003Cem\u003Enormally understood as prejudice or hatred against Jewish people as a race\u201d\u003C\/em\u003E before concluding that since Christianity doesn\u2019t perceive the Jews as a race, Christian theology cannot, by definition be anti-Semitic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/brill.com\/display\/book\/edcoll\/9789004274761\/B9789004274761_014.xml\u0022\u003ERevisiting the Charge of Ta\u1e25r\u012bf: The Question of Supersessionism in Early Islam and the Qur\u02be\u0101n\u0026#8217; \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/em\u003ESandra Keiting argues that Islam was supersessionist from its inception, advocating the view that the \u0026#8216;Quranic revelations\u0026#8217; would \u0026#8220;replace the corrupted scriptures possessed by other communities\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.jns.org\/the-cornerstone-of-islamic-replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003EJonathon Feldstein \u003C\/a\u003Eobserves the popular \u0026#8216;Dome of the Rock\u0026#8217; in East Jerusalem has perhaps become \u0026#8220;the cornerstone of Islamic replacement theology\u0026#8221; alongside a new tradition that undermines both Judaism and Christianity. \u0026#8220;Today, it\u2019s commonplace to hear Palestinians and other Muslims deny any Jewish \u2014 and therefore Christian \u2014 history to the Temple Mount, Jerusalem and the Land of Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFeldstein\u0026#8217;s views are supported by a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/mkLs-yOi9gQ?si=ixQudHXxXB9oRJBY\u0022\u003Evideographer who prompted Arab Palestinians to explain the plethora of Jewish archeological sites in the region\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; A\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-isra\/104\u0022\u003El Israa 17.2-104\u003C\/a\u003E;Ta Ha 20.80; Al Mumim 40.53; Al Dukhan 44.32; Al Jathiya 45.16, all refer to Israel as the land of the Jews.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe absurdity of importing apartheid laws to South Africa\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest PSC dogma and its imported \u003Cem\u003Eweltanshauung\u003C\/em\u003E not only seeks to make Jews responsible for apartheid, it criminalises those who profess their religion on the basis of the biblical idea of Zion, in the process relocating South African history to the Middle East.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurthermore, it provides a canon that replaces the narrative of the Hebrews with that of Arab Palestinians, many of whom were migrants from across the former British and Ottoman Empires. One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 1936 economic review in the Damascus newspaper\u003Cstrong\u003E \u003Cem\u003EAl Ayam\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/strong\u003E corroborates by complaining. \u003Cem\u003E\u201cWhole villages in the Hauran have been emptied of their people, who are drifting into [Mandate] Palestine. Count De Martel, French High Commissioner for Syria, asserted in the summer of 1934 that even Arab merchants were moving from Damascus to [Mandate] Palestine because of the prosperity there.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u00a0domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u00a0\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREAD: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003EDebunked: Palestinians and Jews, each form a distinct race \u0026amp; the conflict is thus like apartheid,\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/apartheid\/\u0022\u003E#Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/gaza\/\u0022\u003E#Gaza\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/israel\/\u0022\u003E#Israel\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/palestine\/\u0022\u003E#Palestine\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003E#ReplacementTheology\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/27832\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. item.title: [Update] Note: Gaza: Step back from the…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28766","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EGaza: Step back from the war before it is too late Mr Ramaphosa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFOR DECADES South Africa\u0026#8217;s ruling ANC has clung to the notion that solidarity with the Palestinian cause translates into influencing events on the ground. Yet the upshot of expelling the Israeli ambassador Eliav Belotsercovsky following the atrocity of 7\/10, appears to be an ingress into the conflict arena, a tit-for-tat \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/04\/10\/dear-ebrahim-rasool\/\u0022\u003Eexpulsion of Ebrahim Rasool from Washington.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOur ICJ case has emboldened Republicans to call for sanctions and boycotts against our country (one of many consequences of taking sides) leading SA Jewish Report\u0026#8217;s Howard Sackstein to write, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.sajr.co.za\/cyril-was-it-worth-it\/\u0022\u003ECyril , was it worth it?\u003C\/a\u003E Worse , South African lawfare has turned into a political circus \u0026#8212; with a veritable line-up of dictators, rogues and monarchs in the region, diluting what may be said to comprise our nation\u0026#8217;s democratic appeal and moral clarity before the court.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf like Swaziland and the Saudis, we condone absolute monarchy, and are not promoting the secular frame of our democratic constitution, with its emphasis on human rights, equality, religious freedom and protection of minorities within the general body politic, what exactly are we pursuing other than sheer blindness to \u0026#8216;rule of law\u0026#8217;?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere the late Nelson Mandela was decidedly bipartisan on the issue, promoting a two-state solution that would allow both sides to coexist, successive ANC administrations have gradually adopted the maximalist view, consistent with those like \u0026#8216;Islamic Jihad for Palestine\u0026#8217; who wish to eliminate Israel, to remove the Jews from the Middle East. All of which begs the question, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2021\/11\/18\/what-if-israel-didnt-exist-isacowitz-vs-shain\/\u0022\u003Ewhere would half of all the Jews living in the world go,\u003C\/a\u003E if they were removed under objectives outlined by Hamas, or promoted by Fatah with its \u0026#8216;pay-for-slay\u0026#8217; programe?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBarrister Natasha Hausdorff of \u0026#8216;UK Lawyers for Israel\u0026#8217; asserts South Africa\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=6wrhzDBvhEc\u0022\u003Eclaims of genocide, occupation and apartheid\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 are a canard, an \u0026#8216;untrue blood libel without basis in international law\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/a\u003E In the instance of our ICJ case, our claim, she says, is merely a legal hook on which to draw Israel before the court, since Israel is a signatory to the Genocide Convention, which came about because of the Holocaust. In addition the legal definition she says, requires intention to commit genocide, an element that she avers is entirely missing given the sequence of events following 7\/10.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsent the Hamas-led, live-streamed slaughter of Israelis on that tragic day, which included disabled victims considered too much trouble to hold hostage, or the cold-blooded slaying of black Kenyan students, one may well be mislead into believing Israel has a genocidal motive in the conflict. The resulting war has been particularly devastating for the population of Gaza given Hamas refusal to provide shelter and aid for its citizens. Instead of bomb shelters we have seen tunnels with munitions, secondary explosions, as Israel plays \u003Cem\u003Ewackamole\u003C\/em\u003E, in one of the densest urban environments, this whilst the Islamic group is accused of denying access to food aid transferred during the ceasefire period.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAccording to Hausdorff\u0026#8217;s evidence before the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/J6GoUJj4Fk\u0022\u003EUK House of Commons Foreign Affairs committee\u003C\/a\u003E, last week, the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/reliefweb.int\/report\/occupied-palestinian-territory\/famine-review-committee-review-famine-early-warning-systems-network-fews-net-ipc-compatible-analysis-northern-governorates-gaza-strip-conclusions-and-recommendations-may-2024\u0022\u003EUN famine review committee\u003C\/a\u003E found claims of famine by the IPC implausible considering the amount of aid which has entered Gaza. She points to calorific content exceeding NHS guidelines and the sheer weight of aid delivered during the recent ceasefire, amounting to several months of food for each and every Gazan. Instead she fingers Hamas\u0026#8217;s active diversion of aid, as one of the tactics used to blame Israel in a psychological war that has deployed martyrdom as a tactic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile pro-Israel attorneys such as Hausdorff are quick to promote the idea of a \u0026#8216;moral army fighting terrorism\u0026#8217;, with one of the \u0026#8216;lowest combatant to civilian kill ratios of any conflict in the world\u0026#8217;, the mounting death-toll and prospect of starvation of the general population caused by the Jihadist logic behind the conflict, puts paid to the notion that anyone can simply, step back from actively promoting a cessation to hostilities on both sides.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EParticularly appalling is the manner in which South Africa has repeated the mistakes of its near distant past. Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to Hitler\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Final Solution\u0026#8217;, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior ( under the Smuts government) DF Malan, who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Germany\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by IDF artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Middle East states, some of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the wholesale sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back our allies from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure.
