All of which begs the question, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2021\/11\/18\/what-if-israel-didnt-exist-isacowitz-vs-shain\/\u0022\u003Ewhere would half of all the Jews living in the world go,\u003C\/a\u003E if they were removed under objectives outlined by Hamas, or promoted by Fatah with its \u0026#8216;pay-for-slay\u0026#8217; programe?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBarrister Natasha Hausdorff of \u0026#8216;UK Lawyers for Israel\u0026#8217; asserts South Africa\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=6wrhzDBvhEc\u0022\u003Eclaims of genocide, occupation and apartheid\u0026#8217;,\u00a0 are a canard, an \u0026#8216;untrue blood libel without basis in international law\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/a\u003E In the instance of our ICJ case, our claim, she says, is merely a legal hook on which to draw Israel before the court, since Israel is a signatory to the Genocide Convention, which came about because of the Holocaust. In addition the legal definition she says, requires intention to commit genocide, an element that she avers is entirely missing given the sequence of events following 7\/10.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsent the Hamas-led, live-streamed slaughter of Israelis on that tragic day, which included disabled victims considered too much trouble to hold hostage, or the cold-blooded slaying of black Kenyan students, one may well be mislead into believing Israel has a genocidal motive in the conflict. The resulting war has been particularly devastating for the population of Gaza given Hamas refusal to provide shelter and aid for its citizens. Instead of bomb shelters we have seen tunnels with munitions, secondary explosions, as Israel plays \u003Cem\u003Ewackamole\u003C\/em\u003E, in one of the densest urban environments, this whilst the Islamic group is accused of denying access to food aid transferred during the ceasefire period.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAccording to Hausdorff\u0026#8217;s evidence before the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/J6GoUJj4Fk\u0022\u003EUK House of Commons Foreign Affairs committee\u003C\/a\u003E, last week, the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/reliefweb.int\/report\/occupied-palestinian-territory\/famine-review-committee-review-famine-early-warning-systems-network-fews-net-ipc-compatible-analysis-northern-governorates-gaza-strip-conclusions-and-recommendations-may-2024\u0022\u003EUN famine review committee\u003C\/a\u003E found claims of famine by the IPC implausible considering the amount of aid which has entered Gaza. She points to calorific content exceeding NHS guidelines and the sheer weight of aid delivered during the recent ceasefire, amounting to several months of food for each and every Gazan. Instead she fingers Hamas\u0026#8217; active diversion of aid, as one of the tactics used to blame Israel in a psychological war that has deployed martyrdom as a tactic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhile pro-Israel attorneys such as Hausdorff are quick to promote the idea of a \u0026#8216;moral army fighting terrorism\u0026#8217;, with one of the \u0026#8216;lowest combatant to civilian kill ratios of any conflict in the world\u0026#8217;, the mounting death-toll and prospect of starvation of the general population caused by the Jihadist logic behind the conflict, puts paid to the notion that anyone can simply, step back from actively promoting a cessation to hostilities on both sides.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EParticularly appalling is the manner in which South Africa has repeated the mistakes of its near distant past. Our nation\u0026#8217;s own complicity in the humanitarian crisis occurring in Gaza harks back to Hitler\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Final Solution\u0026#8217;, a programme of euthanasia of Europe\u0026#8217;s Jewish population by the Nazis which came about following then Minister of Interior ( under the Smuts government) DF Malan, who introduced legislation before the House of Assembly curtailing Jewish immigration to South Africa. A policy which predates the 1938 Evian Conference where world leaders all agreed to implement similar embargoes on Germany with a tragic result \u0026#8212; Germany\u0026#8217;s solution to the problem of Jewish refugees streaming into places like Palestine, was to engage in industrial scale murder.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs one watches the brutal targeting of Gaza, by IDF artificial intelligence, with rockets and missiles still being launched into Israel by Middle East states, some of whom, are pro-slavery and the very antithesis of our secular democracy, one can only remark at how a perfect storm of martyrdom has created the necessary conditions for the wholesale sacrifice of human beings at the mercy of bureaucrats such as those in Pretoria. If our country were providing guaranteed aid and refuge for Gazans and Israelis alike, in fact anyone wishing to flee the conflict, I might think differently.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn both these tragic instances, instead of walking back our allies from an historical pressure cooker, we have encouraged more pressure. We may yet live to regret it, having repeated the mistakes of our nations\u0026#8217; past in not considering peaceful alternatives\u003C\/p\u003E"},"icon":{"type":"Image","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/\/app\/uploads\/2012\/07\/cropped-davidrootshse-2-150x150.jpg","mediaType":"image\/jpeg"},"published":"2025-05-05T10:43:18Z","updated":"2025-05-06T09:49:03Z","url":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/05\/gaza-step-back-from-the-brink-before-it-is-too-late-mr-ramaphosa\/","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"mediaType":"text\/html","replies":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","type":"Collection","first":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies?page=1","type":"CollectionPage","partOf":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/replies","items":[]}},"likes":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/likes","type":"Collection","totalItems":0},"shares":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28766\/shares","type":"Collection","totalItems":0}}

item.title: [Update] Note: Replacement theology at heart of…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2024\/10\/07\/replacement-theology-at-heart-of-middle-east-conflict\/","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. Proposals by the Palestine Solidarity Committee (PSC) for introduction of a bill which will \u0026#8216;domesticate\u0026#8217; the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.un.org\/en\/genocideprevention\/documents\/atrocity-crimes\/Doc.10_International%20Convention%20on%20the%20Suppression%20and%20Punishment%20of%20the%20Crime%20of%20Apartheid.pdf\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E1973 United Nations International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E, alongside the creation of \u0026#8216;apartheid-free zones\u0026#8217; and the criminalization of Zionism, confront us with an absurdity:\u003Cem\u003E it is as if apartheid never happened within South Africa\u003C\/em\u003E,\u003Cem\u003E since it appears no laws were adopted referencing the UN convention\u003C\/em\u003E?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf our 1994 dispensation appears in danger of being replaced by a formidable global campaign connected to a maximalist view of Palestinian territory, associated with the former British Colony, then you may be correct. \u0026#8220;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8221; is the oft heard rallying cry alongside \u0026#8220;Death to Israel and America\u0026#8221;, as anyone with a different viewpoint is shouted down. Yet the \u0026#8216;rainbow-coloured\u0026#8217; demonstrators have not translated into \u0026#8216;rainbow ideas\u0026#8217; in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is because replacement theology is at the heart of the conflict. A 2020 academic paper by Philip Du Toit on the question:\u003Ca href=\u0022http:\/\/www.scielo.org.za\/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext\u0026amp;pid=S2305-08532020000100007\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022noreferrer noopener\u0022\u003E\u00a0\u0026#8216;Is Replacement Theology Anti-Semitic?\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026#8216;\u00a0begins by defining anti-Semitism as \u201c\u003Cem\u003Enormally understood as prejudice or hatred against Jewish people as a race\u201d\u003C\/em\u003E before concluding that since Christianity doesn\u2019t perceive the Jews as a race, Christian theology cannot, by definition be anti-Semitic.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn \u0026#8216;\u003Cem\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/brill.com\/display\/book\/edcoll\/9789004274761\/B9789004274761_014.xml\u0022\u003ERevisiting the Charge of Ta\u1e25r\u012bf: The Question of Supersessionism in Early Islam and the Qur\u02be\u0101n\u0026#8217; \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/em\u003ESandra Keiting argues that Islam was supersessionist from its inception, advocating the view that the \u0026#8216;Quranic revelations\u0026#8217; would \u0026#8220;replace the corrupted scriptures possessed by other communities\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.jns.org\/the-cornerstone-of-islamic-replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003EJonathon Feldstein \u003C\/a\u003Eobserves the popular \u0026#8216;Dome of the Rock\u0026#8217; in East Jerusalem has perhaps become \u0026#8220;the cornerstone of Islamic replacement theology\u0026#8221; alongside a new tradition that undermines both Judaism and Christianity. \u0026#8220;Today, it\u2019s commonplace to hear Palestinians and other Muslims deny any Jewish \u2014 and therefore Christian \u2014 history to the Temple Mount, Jerusalem and the Land of Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFeldstein\u0026#8217;s views are supported by a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/mkLs-yOi9gQ?si=ixQudHXxXB9oRJBY\u0022\u003Evideographer who prompted Arab Palestinians to explain the plethora of Jewish archeological sites in the region\u003C\/a\u003E \u0026#8212; their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; A\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-isra\/104\u0022\u003El Israa 17.2-104\u003C\/a\u003E;Ta Ha 20.80; Al Mumim 40.53; Al Dukhan 44.32; Al Jathiya 45.16, all refer to Israel as the land of the Jews.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe absurdity of importing apartheid laws to South Africa\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest PSC dogma and its imported \u003Cem\u003Eweltanshauung\u003C\/em\u003E not only seeks to make Jews responsible for apartheid, it criminalises those who profess their religion on the basis of the biblical idea of Zion, in the process relocating South African history to the Middle East.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurthermore, it provides a canon that replaces the narrative of the Hebrews with that of Arab Palestinians, many of whom were migrants from across the former British and Ottoman Empires. One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 1936 economic review in the Damascus newspaper\u003Cstrong\u003E \u003Cem\u003EAl Ayam\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/strong\u003E corroborates by complaining. \u003Cem\u003E\u201cWhole villages in the Hauran have been emptied of their people, who are drifting into [Mandate] Palestine. Count De Martel, French High Commissioner for Syria, asserted in the summer of 1934 that even Arab merchants were moving from Damascus to [Mandate] Palestine because of the prosperity there.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u00a0domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u00a0\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/pressreader.com\/article\/281548001773333\u0022\u003EPublished in full by Daily News 7 May 2025\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EREAD: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003EDebunked: Palestinians and Jews, each form a distinct race \u0026amp; the conflict is thus like apartheid,\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/s0wzNtLm5AA?si=11iSO0UZsjDetyND\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/apartheid\/\u0022\u003E#Apartheid\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/gaza\/\u0022\u003E#Gaza\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/israel\/\u0022\u003E#Israel\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/palestine\/\u0022\u003E#Palestine\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/replacement-theology\/\u0022\u003E#ReplacementTheology\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/tag\/south-africa\/\u0022\u003E#SouthAfrica\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/27832\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EReplacement theology at heart of Middle East conflict\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOUR COUNTRY to its credit has enacted legislation to suppress both apartheid and racism. their answers invariably involve a denial of history, for them, the scientific evidence is a religious \u0026#8216;falsehood\u0026#8217; to be discarded and ignored, replaced by another narrative, one which seeks to overcome and replace proven historical facts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEven the Koran references the land of Israel. \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-baqarah\/47\u0022\u003EAl Baqara 2.47\u003C\/a\u003E ; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-maidah\/21\u0022\u003EAl Maida 5.21\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/legacy.quran.com\/7\/137\u0022\u003EAl Aaraf 7.137\u003C\/a\u003E; \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/10\/93?translations=101,19,85,20,18,17\u0022\u003EYunus 10.93\u003C\/a\u003E; A\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/quran.com\/en\/al-isra\/104\u0022\u003El Israa 17.2-104\u003C\/a\u003E;Ta Ha 20.80; Al Mumim 40.53; Al Dukhan 44.32; Al Jathiya 45.16, all refer to Israel as the land of the Jews.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe absurdity of importing apartheid laws to South Africa\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe latest PSC dogma and its imported \u003Cem\u003Eweltanshauung\u003C\/em\u003E not only seeks to make Jews responsible for apartheid, it criminalises those who profess their religion on the basis of the biblical idea of Zion, in the process relocating South African history to the Middle East.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFurthermore, it provides a canon that replaces the narrative of the Hebrews with that of Arab Palestinians, many of whom were migrants from across the former British and Ottoman Empires. One has merely to examine the history of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.britannica.com\/topic\/Hejaz-Railway\u0022\u003EOttoman Railway Company\u003C\/a\u003E to see why this statement is true. Beginning in 1900, the main line from Damascus to Haifa, allowed mass migration to the new economy surrounding the Zionist endeavor, and the claim is supported by the census data.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 1936 economic review in the Damascus newspaper\u003Cstrong\u003E \u003Cem\u003EAl Ayam\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/strong\u003E corroborates by complaining. \u003Cem\u003E\u201cWhole villages in the Hauran have been emptied of their people, who are drifting into [Mandate] Palestine. Count De Martel, French High Commissioner for Syria, asserted in the summer of 1934 that even Arab merchants were moving from Damascus to [Mandate] Palestine because of the prosperity there.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReplacement theology as it is constructed in recent times, may be understood as the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ebasis for the apartheid analogy,\u003C\/a\u003E a process whereby the history of our own country, is similarly replaced and discarded in the furtherance of a strategy which has been termed \u003Cem\u003Esupersessionism.\u003C\/em\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is therefore significant that the UN apartheid convention targets crimes against humanity \u201c\u003Cem\u003Ecommitted in the context of an institutionalized regime of systematic oppression and\u00a0domination by \u003Cstrong\u003Eone racial group over any other racial group or groups\u00a0\u003C\/strong\u003Eand committed with the intention of maintaining that regime.\u003C\/em\u003E\u201d [my bold]\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPerversely, the phrase \u003Cem\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E\u0026#8216;one racial group over any other racial group or groups\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8216; is routinely omitted by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and PSC, in order to redact the convention to\u003Cem\u003E instances of state oppression of minorities, \u003C\/em\u003Ea lamentable situation not uncommon in our world today and certainly not unique to the state of Israel and its neighbors, all of whom should take the blame for the current escalation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe apartheid convention was enacted in the 1970s primarily to deal with apartheid\u003Cem\u003E as it was then constructed within South Africa\u0026#8217;s borders\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; a racist segregationist policy associated with a white Christian minority regime of PW Botha \u003Cem\u003Eet al\u003C\/em\u003E \u0026#8212; absolutely nothing to do with Jews, who under apartheid were disproportionately jailed compared to their white Christian compatriots, with outspoken Rabbis deported by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only genuine question raised by the PSC proposal, (whatever the merits), is whether or not our foreign policy should reflect our constitutional values? At the face of it, foreign policy is best served by an outlook which boldly supports our constitution \u0026#8212;\u00a0 its democratic values \u0026#8212; it cannot be that we as a nation are compelled to support those like Hamas or Hezbollah, who are avowedly opposed to secularism, democratic centralism, women\u0026#8217;s rights, LGBT rights, independent trade unions, and other rights.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn doing so, we risk rewriting and fabricating our own history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca item.title: [Create] Note: Chatbot tales: xAI Grok hacked,…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28794","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EChatbot tales: xAI Grok hacked, Claude master prompt leaked, \u0026#038; Qaanita Hunter issues robo-fatwa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENO sooner had the chatbot Grok malfunctioned, interjecting normal chats on x.com with snippets about \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221;, the incident was being reported to the company, xAI who immediately took corrective action.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAn \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/xai\/status\/1923183620606619649\u0022\u003Eunprecedented statement by the company states\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003EOn May 14 at approximately 3:15 AM PST, an unauthorized modification was made to the Grok response bot\u0026#8217;s prompt on X. This change, which directed Grok to provide a specific response on a political topic, violated xAI\u0026#8217;s internal policies and core values.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;We have conducted a thorough investigation and are implementing measures to enhance Grok\u0026#8217;s transparency and reliability. What we\u2019re going to do next: \u0026#8211; Starting now, we are publishing our Grok system prompts openly on GitHub. The public will be able to review them and give feedback to every prompt change that we make to Grok. We hope this can help strengthen your trust in Grok as a truth-seeking AI. \u0026#8211; Our existing code review process for prompt changes was circumvented in this incident.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ExAI says it will be putting in place \u0026#8216;additional checks and measures to ensure that xAI employees can\u0026#8217;t modify the prompt without review.\u0026#8217; The company is also implementing a 24\/7 monitoring team to respond to incidents with Grok\u2019s answers that are not caught by automated systems, so we can respond faster if all other measures fail.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EIncident raises questions\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/search?q=grok%20ai%20white%20genocide%20incident\u0026amp;src=typed_query\u0022\u003Eseveral hours in which Grok was responding to unrelated user queries\u003C\/a\u003E with additional information related to the disputed \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221; news-story (even adding that it was disputed), then admitting in other chats, it was being prompted to do so, certainly raise issues in regard to the manner in which these models can be hacked, manipulated and redirected by employees, external agents, or rogue actors in a method known as prompting.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis year a hacker demonstrated how Microsoft\u0026#8217;s Copilot could be coaxed into revealing secure data normally protected by security tags in a hacking method known as \u0026#8216;social engineering\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo its credit xAi and the LLM industry has shown itself willing and able to self-regulate, but of course, the controversy plays into the hands of regulators, in particular, those who not only perceive a conspiracy involving Elon Musk with his background in South Africa, but who genuinely fear the rise of artificial intelligence.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENews24\u0026#8217;s Qaanitah Hunter practically had a meltdown on South African television about the incident, calling it \u0026#8216;an unprecedented attack on the nation\u0026#8217;s sovereignty\u0026#8221;. Hunter literally accuses Musk of being the man behind the \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221; story and is\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.news24.com\/opinions\/columnists\/qaanitah-hunter-musks-grok-malfunction-exposes-sas-weakness-in-technopolar-world-20250518-1152\u0022\u003E calling for artificial intelligence to be restricted\u003C\/a\u003E by South African regulators by muzzling those chatbots who do not give the right answers to our lawmakers and politicians.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe question arises whether AI enjoys any of the free speech guarantees awarded human beings in our Constitution? To what degree are they considered influential, given that early versions seemed to hallucinate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis week, the master prompt for popular\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/raw.githubusercontent.com\/asgeirtj\/system_prompts_leaks\/refs\/heads\/main\/claude.txt\u0022\u003E LLM Claude was leaked via reddit. \u003C\/a\u003EIt is a fascinating example of post-training prompting. You can view the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/XjYugVV4Zt\u0022\u003E xAI chat prompts here\u003C\/a\u003E too.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022jetpack-video-wrapper\u0022\u003E\u003Ciframe loading=\u0022lazy\u0022 title=\u0022AI under fire\u0022 width=\u0022780\u0022 height=\u0022439\u0022 src=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/EkPBP_lqX1s?feature=oembed\u0022 frameborder=\u00220\u0022 allow=\u0022accelerometer; item.title: [Announce] Create: Chatbot tales: xAI Grok hacked,…
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?post_type=ap_outbox\u0026p=28802","type":"Create","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","published":"2025-05-21T07:12:54Z","to":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams#Public"],"cc":["https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/actors\/2\/followers"],"object":{"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28794","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EChatbot tales: xAI Grok hacked, Claude master prompt leaked, \u0026#038; Qaanita Hunter issues robo-fatwa\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENO sooner had the chatbot Grok malfunctioned, interjecting normal chats on x.com with snippets about \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221;, the incident was being reported to the company, xAI who immediately took corrective action.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAn \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/xai\/status\/1923183620606619649\u0022\u003Eunprecedented statement by the company states\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;\u003C\/em\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003EOn May 14 at approximately 3:15 AM PST, an unauthorized modification was made to the Grok response bot\u0026#8217;s prompt on X. This change, which directed Grok to provide a specific response on a political topic, violated xAI\u0026#8217;s internal policies and core values.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003E\u003Cem\u003E\u0026#8220;We have conducted a thorough investigation and are implementing measures to enhance Grok\u0026#8217;s transparency and reliability. What we\u2019re going to do next: \u0026#8211; Starting now, we are publishing our Grok system prompts openly on GitHub. The public will be able to review them and give feedback to every prompt change that we make to Grok. We hope this can help strengthen your trust in Grok as a truth-seeking AI. \u0026#8211; Our existing code review process for prompt changes was circumvented in this incident.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003ExAI says it will be putting in place \u0026#8216;additional checks and measures to ensure that xAI employees can\u0026#8217;t modify the prompt without review.\u0026#8217; The company is also implementing a 24\/7 monitoring team to respond to incidents with Grok\u2019s answers that are not caught by automated systems, so we can respond faster if all other measures fail.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EIncident raises questions\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/x.com\/search?q=grok%20ai%20white%20genocide%20incident\u0026amp;src=typed_query\u0022\u003Eseveral hours in which Grok was responding to unrelated user queries\u003C\/a\u003E with additional information related to the disputed \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221; news-story (even adding that it was disputed), then admitting in other chats, it was being prompted to do so, certainly raise issues in regard to the manner in which these models can be hacked, manipulated and redirected by employees, external agents, or rogue actors in a method known as prompting.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis year a hacker demonstrated how Microsoft\u0026#8217;s Copilot could be coaxed into revealing secure data normally protected by security tags in a hacking method known as \u0026#8216;social engineering\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETo its credit xAi and the LLM industry has shown itself willing and able to self-regulate, but of course, the controversy plays into the hands of regulators, in particular, those who not only perceive a conspiracy involving Elon Musk with his background in South Africa, but who genuinely fear the rise of artificial intelligence.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENews24\u0026#8217;s Qaanitah Hunter practically had a meltdown on South African television about the incident, calling it \u0026#8216;an unprecedented attack on the nation\u0026#8217;s sovereignty\u0026#8221;. Hunter literally accuses Musk of being the man behind the \u0026#8220;White Genocide\u0026#8221; story and is\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.news24.com\/opinions\/columnists\/qaanitah-hunter-musks-grok-malfunction-exposes-sas-weakness-in-technopolar-world-20250518-1152\u0022\u003E calling for artificial intelligence to be restricted\u003C\/a\u003E by South African regulators by muzzling those chatbots who do not give the right answers to our lawmakers and politicians.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe question arises whether AI enjoys any of the free speech guarantees awarded human beings in our Constitution? To what degree are they considered influential, given that early versions seemed to hallucinate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis week, the master prompt for popular\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/raw.githubusercontent.com\/asgeirtj\/system_prompts_leaks\/refs\/heads\/main\/claude.txt\u0022\u003E LLM Claude was leaked via reddit. \u003C\/a\u003EIt is a fascinating example of post-training prompting. You can view the\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/t.co\/XjYugVV4Zt\u0022\u003E xAI chat prompts here\u003C\/a\u003E too.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022jetpack-video-wrapper\u0022\u003E\u003Ciframe loading=\u0022lazy\u0022 title=\u0022AI under fire\u0022 width=\u0022780\u0022 height=\u0022439\u0022 src=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/EkPBP_lqX1s?feature=oembed\u0022 frameborder=\u00220\u0022 allow=\u0022accelerometer; item.title: [Update] Note: Richard Calland: In the Land…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/11\/06\/desiderius-erasmus-in-the-land-of-the-blind-the-one-eyed-man-is-king\/","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ERichard Calland: In the Land of the Blind, the one-eyed man is King \u0026#8211; Desiderius Erasmus\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIN a Mail \u0026amp; Guardian \u0026#8216;Thought Leader\u0026#8217; piece \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/mg.co.za\/thoughtleader\/2023-10-12-beware-the-one-eyed-middle-east-critic\/\u0022\u003EBeware the one-eyed Middle East critic\u0026#8217; (\u003C\/a\u003Ea rather unfortunate title given the casualties on either side, status of critic Salman Rushdie) Richard Calland myopically opines about what he \u0026#8216;observed\u0026#8217; during his year 2000 sojourn in Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf all that was required were a sunny disposition expressed in outward liberalism, as Calland has it, in proceeding to outline what he views as a \u0026#8216;progressive political stance\u0026#8217; on the subject, we could all simply \u0026#8216;make a cup of tea\u0026#8217; and the problem would be solved.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is difficult and near impossible to square Calland\u0026#8217;s narrow-casting of contextualisation, alongside pronouns and micro-aggressions, that sit together with a somewhat effete claim that \u0026#8216;international law matters\u0026#8217; in the absence of any sign that either Hamas or the Israelis actually support international law \u0026#8212; whether resolution 181 (which created the State of Israel) or resolution 242 (which demands a return to the borders of June 14, 1967). Such is the enormity of the tragedy of the past month \u0026#8212; the reality of a situation whose genesis includes two major world wars, and at least seven regional wars since the establishment of Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EInitial jubilation by the Pro-Palestine brigade over the October 7 massacre of over 1400+ persons including women and children, nothing less than a \u0026#8216;victory for Palestinian Resistance\u0026#8217; has turned into dismay and outrage at the long-term humanitarian consequences for Gaza, with little or no prospects for peace for the rest of the world.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe mass gatherings in support of an Hamas theocratic \u0026#8220;End the Occupation\u0026#8221;, with annihilationist calls for Jihad and Global Intifada, and chanting of \u0026#8216;From the River to the Sea\u0026#8217;, have been referred to as \u0026#8216;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=uTbd9tg7WPY\u0022\u003Ehate marches\u0026#8217; by UK Home Secretary Suella Braverman,\u003C\/a\u003E since according to her, this is a demand for the \u0026#8216;elimination of Israel and its replacement by an Islamic State\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENevertheless, Calland persists in his intellectual parlour game, which from a post-October perspective, is really an anachronistic attempt to fit the Middle East into a South African playbook. We all know how apartheid turned out, it must follow that if we assign the right labels, impose politically correct contexts and virtue signal within our individual matricies of morality, (sprinkling Rainbow-coloured fairy dust on the situation), then peace will break out and we can all go home for, yes, another cup of tea?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Substitute \u201cArabs\u201d for \u201cblacks\u201d and you can hear a South African cop of a certain demographic say exactly the same, can\u2019t you? And with the same level of outrageous presumption \u2014 that because of one\u2019s own race, the level of prejudice will be the same\u0026#8221; he writes. Callend is quick to call out \u0026#8220;the bantustanisation of Palestine; apartheid Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe trouble with this analogy \u0026#8212; it is only vaguely useful when discussing the dynamics of the West Bank \u0026amp; Gaza, which has other comparators \u0026#8212; the San Diego-Tijuana border for instance, thousands of labour migrants cross it each day, so too the partition demographics already in place between North \u0026amp; South Sudan, India \u0026amp; Pakistan and Greek \u0026amp; Turkish Cyprus.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhen stating our experience under apartheid is somehow an exemplar, a template for analysis (you \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ecan read my piece debunking this here\u003C\/a\u003E) , one can only conclude the wholesale redeployment of this narrative is wholly inaccurate when it comes to historical claims, mutual land rights , security and demographics within the MENA region at large. Let us not forget some 800 000 \u0026#8211; 1 Million Mizrahi Jews (who include Arab Jews from Morocco, Egypt, Yemen Lebanon, Syria, Iran \u0026amp; Iraq) who were forcibly dispossessed prior to and immediately following the creation of Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe Farhud\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe dropped narrative of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/encyclopedia.ushmm.org\/content\/en\/article\/the-farhud\u0022\u003EFarhud \u003C\/a\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/encyclopedia.ushmm.org\/content\/en\/article\/the-farhud\u0022\u003E(Arabic for Pogrom) \u003C\/a\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/encyclopedia.ushmm.org\/content\/en\/article\/the-farhud\u0022\u003Emassacre and dispossession of Bagdad Jews in 1941 \u003C\/a\u003Ewhich immediately preceded the Shoah, (both events where Palestinian leader Amin al-Husseini was one of many Arab supporters of the Final Solution) \u0026#8212; represent an extremely long list of similar massacres and forced removals of Jews at the hands of Islamists.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMassacres like that which occurred during Operation Al Aqsa flood, 7\/10 last month, stretch all the way back to the 1066 Granada Massacre, in which \u0026#8216;Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela was slaughtered alongside most of the local Jewish population\u0026#8217; and the earlier 1033 Fez Massacre in which some 6000 Jews were similarly dispatched following the \u0026#8216;conquest of the Moroccan city from the Maghrawa tribe by, the forces of Abu\u0026#8217;l Kamal Tamim, chief of the Banu Ifran\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThat today\u0026#8217;s Pro-Palestinian activists openly call for Jihad, whilst readily reciting a religious text referring to the Khayber Pass battle in 628 CE between early Muslims, led by Muhammad, and the Arabian Jews living in Khayber, fuels ethno-religious lunacy in which \u0026#8216;Bibi the Butcher of Gaza\u0026#8217; has been equally reciting similar passages from the old Testament referring to the \u0026#8216;Tribe of Amalek\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs many South African\u0026#8217;s reach back into anti-apartheid theology, the eschatological distraction may appear to be of necessity rather than simple virtue. It is most certainly inappropriate and futile when it comes to apportioning blame, pressurizing the belligerents, and arriving at mutual agreement and cessation of hostilities.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENevertheless one must strive, hope and pray that a Secular Freedom Charter and TRC emerges in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EFanonian rhetoric \u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor all the Fanonian rhetoric of \u0026#8216;oppressor and oppressed\u0026#8217;, the easy resort to the apartheid libel, (which echoes the earlier blood libel of the Middle Ages, where Jews were accused of murdering Christ and worse), what has occurred over the past month, and even past decade, has been an increase in polarisation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPainting the conflict within Manichean terms of good and evil, black and white, has merely acted to provide those who advocate terror a blank cheque to \u0026#8216;do what thy will\u0026#8217;, whilst emboldening the far right with similar ambitions within Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENations are not races. Strip away the misaligned academic hypothesis, the unproven intellectualism posited by career bureaucrats who never bother to peer review nor debate their findings, and what you have are mutually incompatible systems of justice. Religious disagreements on which law and which state should govern, over which territory \u0026#8212; and a proxy war being fought over the Final Status of Jerusalem. It should not be possible to reduce this conflict to a moral proposition of which is the lesser of the three evils \u0026#8212; a Jerusalem controlled by Israel, a Jerusalem partitioned by Fatah, or a Jerusualem erased by Hamas and renamed Quds?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet the blathering \u0026#8216;progressives\u0026#8217; of the myopic middle, those who merely echo the lunatic left, continue to issue their \u0026#8216;dime-a-dozen\u0026#8217;, pronouncements. Statements such as: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003Eanalysis and understanding must always be contextual, because non-progressive politics is so often characterised by acontextual and ahistorical claims. Seeking to identify the underlying structural and other causes of a \u201cwicked\u201d problem, rather than baying at the symptoms, is what sets progressives apart\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8220;, appear callous and hollow if what occurs is precisely that \u0026#8212; the dropping of contexts and assertion of ahistorical claims?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf Calland were actually seeking a diagnosis with a prognosis, he would immediately call-out the dropped contexts and missing narratives of the Nakba-grifters, those who forget historical Palestine was once a British Colony alongside Transjordan, accuse all and sundry of wholesale land theft, then dispute the outcome of both World Wars, before proceeding to inflate \u0026amp; conflate their own oppression, whilst denying the historical oppression of others in the region?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIntersectionality is neither the sole preserve of queers nor feminists but of necessity also includes Palestinians, Jews, Arabs and Israelis. Only by addressing objective historical facts, can there be hope of a justificable solution, one that is capable of being resolved under International Law. And by that I mean embracing the \u0026#8216;progressiveness of realists\u0026#8217; instead of over-identification with any one cause.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.thefp.com\/p\/israel-is-nothing-like-apartheid-jim-crow\u0022\u003EThe belief that Israel is analogous to apartheid South Africa or Jim Crow America has no basis in history. \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.spiked-online.com\/2023\/10\/11\/no-hamas-is-not-struggling-against-apartheid\/\u0022\u003ENo, Hamas is not struggling against \u2018apartheid\u2019\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026lt;script async src=\u0026#8221;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/pagead2.googlesyndication.com\/pagead\/js\/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-1630578712653878\u0026#038;#8243\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022nofollow noopener noreferrer\u0022 translate=\u0022no\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022invisible\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022ellipsis\u0022\u003Epagead2.googlesyndication.com\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022invisible\u0022\u003Epagead\/js\/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-1630578712653878\u0026amp;#8243\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E; We all know how apartheid turned out, it must follow that if we assign the right labels, impose politically correct contexts and virtue signal within our individual matricies of morality, (sprinkling Rainbow-coloured fairy dust on the situation), then peace will break out and we can all go home for, yes, another cup of tea?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;Substitute \u201cArabs\u201d for \u201cblacks\u201d and you can hear a South African cop of a certain demographic say exactly the same, can\u2019t you? And with the same level of outrageous presumption \u2014 that because of one\u2019s own race, the level of prejudice will be the same\u0026#8221; he writes. Callend is quick to call out \u0026#8220;the bantustanisation of Palestine; apartheid Israel.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe trouble with this analogy \u0026#8212; it is only vaguely useful when discussing the dynamics of the West Bank \u0026amp; Gaza, which has other comparators \u0026#8212; the San Diego-Tijuana border for instance, thousands of labour migrants cross it each day, so too the partition demographics already in place between North \u0026amp; South Sudan, India \u0026amp; Pakistan and Greek \u0026amp; Turkish Cyprus.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhen stating our experience under apartheid is somehow an exemplar, a template for analysis (you \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2023\/02\/13\/debunked-palestinians-and-jews-each-form-a-distinct-race-the-conflict-is-thus-like-apartheid\/\u0022\u003Ecan read my piece debunking this here\u003C\/a\u003E) , one can only conclude the wholesale redeployment of this narrative is wholly inaccurate when it comes to historical claims, mutual land rights , security and demographics within the MENA region at large. Let us not forget some 800 000 \u0026#8211; 1 Million Mizrahi Jews (who include Arab Jews from Morocco, Egypt, Yemen Lebanon, Syria, Iran \u0026amp; Iraq) who were forcibly dispossessed prior to and immediately following the creation of Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe Farhud\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe dropped narrative of the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/encyclopedia.ushmm.org\/content\/en\/article\/the-farhud\u0022\u003EFarhud\u00a0\u003C\/a\u003E \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/encyclopedia.ushmm.org\/content\/en\/article\/the-farhud\u0022\u003Emassacre and dispossession of Bagdad Jews in 1941 \u003C\/a\u003Ewhich immediately preceded the Shoah, (both events where Palestinian leader Amin al-Husseini was one of many Arab supporters of the Final Solution, Farhud is Arabic for Pogrom)) \u0026#8212; represent an extremely long list of similar massacres and forced removals of Jews at the hands of Islamists.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMassacres like that which occurred during Operation Al Aqsa flood, 7\/10 last month, stretch all the way back to the 1066 Granada Massacre, in which \u0026#8216;Jewish vizier Joseph ibn Naghrela was slaughtered alongside most of the local Jewish population\u0026#8217; and the earlier 1033 Fez Massacre in which some 6000 Jews were similarly dispatched following the \u0026#8216;conquest of the Moroccan city from the Maghrawa tribe by, the forces of Abu\u0026#8217;l Kamal Tamim, chief of the Banu Ifran\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThat today\u0026#8217;s Pro-Palestinian activists openly call for Jihad, whilst readily reciting a religious text referring to the Khayber Pass battle in 628 CE between early Muslims, led by Muhammad, and the Arabian Jews living in Khayber, fuels ethno-religious lunacy in which \u0026#8216;Bibi the Butcher of Gaza\u0026#8217; has been equally reciting similar passages from the old Testament referring to the \u0026#8216;Tribe of Amalek\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs many South African\u0026#8217;s reach back into anti-apartheid theology, the eschatological distraction may appear to be of necessity rather than simple virtue. It is most certainly inappropriate and futile when it comes to apportioning blame, pressurizing the belligerents, and arriving at mutual agreement and cessation of hostilities.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENevertheless one must strive, hope and pray that a Secular Freedom Charter and TRC emerges in the Middle East?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EFanonian rhetoric \u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor all the Fanonian rhetoric of \u0026#8216;oppressor and oppressed\u0026#8217;, the easy resort to the apartheid libel, (which echoes the earlier blood libel of the Middle Ages, where Jews were accused of murdering Christ and worse), what has occurred over the past month, and even past decade, has been an increase in polarisation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPainting the conflict within Manichean terms of good and evil, black and white, has merely acted to provide those who advocate terror a blank cheque to \u0026#8216;do what thy will\u0026#8217;, whilst emboldening the far right with similar ambitions within Israel.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENations are not races. Strip away the misaligned academic hypothesis, the unproven intellectualism posited by career bureaucrats who never bother to peer review nor debate their findings, and what you have are mutually incompatible systems of justice. Religious disagreements on which law and which state should govern, over which territory \u0026#8212; and a proxy war being fought over the Final Status of Jerusalem. It should not be possible to reduce this conflict to a moral proposition of which is the lesser of the three evils \u0026#8212; a Jerusalem controlled by Israel, a Jerusalem partitioned by Fatah, or a Jerusualem erased by Hamas and renamed Quds?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet the blathering \u0026#8216;progressives\u0026#8217; of the myopic middle, those who merely echo the lunatic left, continue to issue their \u0026#8216;dime-a-dozen\u0026#8217;, pronouncements. Statements such as: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003Eanalysis and understanding must always be contextual, because non-progressive politics is so often characterised by acontextual and ahistorical claims. Seeking to identify the underlying structural and other causes of a \u201cwicked\u201d problem, rather than baying at the symptoms, is what sets progressives apart\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026#8220;, appear callous and hollow if what occurs is precisely that \u0026#8212; the dropping of contexts and assertion of ahistorical claims?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf Calland were actually seeking a diagnosis with a prognosis, he would immediately call-out the dropped contexts and missing narratives of the Nakba-grifters, those who forget historical Palestine was once a British Colony alongside Transjordan, accuse all and sundry of wholesale land theft, then dispute the outcome of both World Wars, before proceeding to inflate \u0026amp; conflate their own oppression, whilst denying the historical oppression of others in the region?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIntersectionality is neither the sole preserve of queers nor feminists but of necessity also includes Palestinians, Jews, Arabs and Israelis. Only by addressing objective historical facts, can there be hope of a justificable solution, one that is capable of being resolved under International Law. And by that I mean embracing the \u0026#8216;progressiveness of realists\u0026#8217; instead of over-identification with any one cause.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.thefp.com\/p\/israel-is-nothing-like-apartheid-jim-crow\u0022\u003EThe belief that Israel is analogous to apartheid South Africa or Jim Crow America has no basis in history. \u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESEE: \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.spiked-online.com\/2023\/10\/11\/no-hamas-is-not-struggling-against-apartheid\/\u0022\u003ENo, Hamas is not struggling against \u2018apartheid\u2019\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026lt;script async src=\u0026#8221;\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/pagead2.googlesyndication.com\/pagead\/js\/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-1630578712653878\u0026#038;#8243\u0022 target=\u0022_blank\u0022 rel=\u0022nofollow noopener noreferrer\u0022 translate=\u0022no\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022invisible\u0022\u003Ehttps:\/\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022ellipsis\u0022\u003Epagead2.googlesyndication.com\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022invisible\u0022\u003Epagead\/js\/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-1630578712653878\u0026amp;#8243\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E; item.title: [Create] Note: Trump “White Genocide, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump \u0026#8220;White Genocide, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (see here), and failing to report the truth of the matter,\u00a0 the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, but rather an intervention. But in their hasty, ready-to-consume buzz points, instantly propagating on news feeds, the world was asked to ignore the evidence.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was a simple question by a member of the press who asked our President in the oval office: were claims of a white Genocide true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possible be correct, had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuizen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump\u0026#8217;s had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, which everyone knew was coming, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only time the word appears, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, is in relation to the ICJ case.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump said, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, but his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths and he wanted our President to watch a video. The lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment in which a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Rampaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning genuine disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, he stated. We all want the killings to end.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, regicide, the intention to murder a King, fratricide, the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters, genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the intention to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe intention is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates is an attempt to obfuscates murders within a trade or profession. The central claim is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing land invasions, and horrific incidents to go unchecked.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, has signaled that Pretoria has no intention of protecting property rights or defending the rights of farmers.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting the same straw-man arguments promoted by a local Security Studies think-tank, as Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin the narrative about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possible be correct, had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuizen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump\u0026#8217;s had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, which everyone knew was coming, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe only time the word appears, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, is in relation to the ICJ case.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump said, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, but his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths and he wanted our President to watch a video. The lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment in which a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Rampaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning genuine disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, he stated. We all want the killings to end.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, regicide, the intention to murder a King, fratricide, the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters, genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the intention to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe intention is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates is an attempt to obfuscates murders within a trade or profession. The central claim is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing land invasions, and horrific incidents to go unchecked.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, has signaled that Pretoria has no intention of protecting property rights or defending the rights of farmers.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting the same straw-man arguments promoted by a local Security Studies think-tank, as Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin the narrative about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating on news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. In\u00a0 their hasty, ready-to-consume buzz points, , the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a white Genocide true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possible be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuizen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump\u0026#8217;s had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Rampaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters, genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, are disguised and dressed up a mere criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing land invasions, and horrific incidents to go unchecked. Instead of investigating the claims are dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity. Think of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, signals hat Pretoria has no intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting the same straw-man arguments promoted by a local Security Studies think-tank\u0026#8217;s Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South \u003Cstrong\u003EAfrica, who can\u0026#8217;t seem to see the picture,\u003C\/strong\u003E as Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a narrative about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade.
