actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. In\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possible be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuizen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our collective opposition to apartheid) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by a local Security Studies think-tank\u0026#8217;s Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possible be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuizen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by a local Security Studies think-tank\u0026#8217;s Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. In\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession.The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Oprah Winfrey were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?sa=t\u0026amp;source=web\u0026amp;rct=j\u0026amp;opi=89978449\u0026amp;url=https:\/\/www.defenceweb.co.za\/sa-defence\/sa-defence-sa-defence\/what-does-the-death-of-14-sandf-soldiers-in-the-drc-reveal-about-south-africas-defence-leadership\/\u0026amp;ved=2ahUKEwiw5ZaBm76NAxXw9AIHHdkzCiAQFnoECBcQAw\u0026amp;usg=AOvVaw1zm6ujA56BvfSAUkOqeCvx\u0022\u003Edeaths of 14 SANDF personnel.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca rel=\u0022tag\u0022 class=\u0022hashtag u-tag u-category\u0022 item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and Whoopi Goldberg were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it,\u00a0 \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein their instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With\u00a0 their cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217; awkward response was these claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not had arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning\u00a0 disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, or defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade.
