With\u00a0 cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212;\u00a0 had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E.\u00a0 Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212;\u00a0 getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to\u00a0 resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (regicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime.\u00a0\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E\u00a0 issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading.\u00a0 He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/South_African_farm_attacks\u0022\u003E472 attacks in 2020 alone)\u003C\/a\u003E, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/South_African_farm_attacks\u0022\u003E472 attacks in 2020 alone)\u003C\/a\u003E, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. item.title: [Update] Note: Trump: ‘White Genocide’, straw-man or…
item.dc:creator: davidrobertlewis
item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28810","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=2","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003ETrump: \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8217;, straw-man or scare-crow?\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA STRAW-MAN a\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957867\u0022\u003Ergument is a logical fallacy that involves misrepresenting an opponent\u0026#8217;s position in a way that is easier to attack. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353957092\u0022\u003EInstead of addressing the actual argument, the arguer distorts it, often exaggerating or simplifying it, and then attacks the distorted version. As Alphabet\u0026#8217;s Gemini puts it: \u0026#8220;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u00226189338750353960413\u0022\u003EThis is like arguing with a \u0026#8220;straw man\u0026#8221; or scarecrow, which is easy to knock down because it\u0026#8217;s not a real person.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter literally arguing with a machine by attacking xAI\u0026#8217;s \u0026#8216;Grok\u0026#8221; for an incident in which it began interjecting normal conversation with weird comments about South Africa\u0026#8217;s alleged \u0026#8216;White Genocide\u0026#8221; (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/21\/chatbot-tales-xai-grok-hacked-claude-master-prompt-leaked-qaanita-hunter-issues-robo-fatwa\/\u0022\u003Esee here\u003C\/a\u003E), and failing to report the truth of the matter, the press moved on to misrepresenting, and practically reinventing a meeting between Donald Trump and Cyril Ramaphosa, perhaps in the belief, the public are idiots?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis was no ambush as moral watchdogs and thought leaders put it, \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.bbc.com\/news\/articles\/ce9vvljen0xo\u0022\u003Ein instantly propagating news feeds\u003C\/a\u003E but rather an intervention. With cloned, ready-to-consume buzz points, the world was asked to ignore the evidence, and disbelieve their eyes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs anyone watching the event, would have noted, it was a simple question by a member of the press which started the ball rolling. Were claims of a \u0026#8216;white genocide\u0026#8217; true? Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s awkward response was revealing \u0026#8212; the claims couldn\u0026#8217;t possibly be correct \u0026#8212; had he not arrived in Washington with a cabinet member and leader of the opposition John Steenhuisen, who apparently is white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIf this were the case, he suggested, wouldn\u0026#8217;t John be dead alongside,\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.enca.com\/news\/els-and-goosen-golfers-dragged-trumps-ambush-safrica-leader\u0022\u003E two champion golfers Retief Goosen and Ernie Els\u003C\/a\u003E, in addition to apartheid financier, Johann Rupert, all white?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had prepared his response to this dramatic moment, given the controversy which had erupted following the \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.whitehouse.gov\/presidential-actions\/2025\/02\/addressing-egregious-actions-of-the-republic-of-south-africa\/\u0022\u003Eproclamation that Afrikaners, in particular farmers, would be granted refugee status\u003C\/a\u003E. Neither the proclamation nor the earlier Presidential order suspending aid programmes with our country, mention the term \u0026#8216;genocide\u0026#8217; in relation to the Afrikaners.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThe press are lying to you\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026#8220;The only time the word appears\u0026#8221;, tweeted, Breitbart\u0026#8217;s Joel Pollak, \u0026#8220;is in relation to the ICJ case\u0026#8221;, and claims of a genocide in South Africa, he says, \u0026#8216;are premature\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn Wednesday Trump openly stated, his mind \u0026#8216;wasn\u0026#8217;t decided on the matter\u0026#8217;, rather, his administration was being inundated with requests for asylum, alongside pages and pages of documented deaths of farmers (\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/en.wikipedia.org\/wiki\/South_African_farm_attacks\u0022\u003E472 attacks in 2020 alone)\u003C\/a\u003E, and he wanted our President to watch a video.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe lights in his office were dimmed, and the world was met with a montage of genocidal statements by far-left MP Julius Malema, an entire stadium chanting \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u0026#8221;. Another segment, a procession of vehicles traveling on a road marked with crosses, one for every farm murder, a well-known demonstration was shown.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt first, Ramaphosa, grinned, attempting to laugh off the multimedia presentation. Then when the crosses segment arrived, he practically fell off his seat, dropping his composure. \u0026#8216;Where is this?\u0026#8217; He asked, feigning disbelief, \u0026#8216;perhaps I better investigate?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETrump had already explained his intervention \u0026#8212; getting this out in the open, will allow South Africa to resolve the problem, \u0026#8216;we all want the killings to end\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThat problem word, Genocide.\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe crime of genocide, which arose in the aftermath of the Holocaust, has nothing to do with numbers. The magnitude of the event is relatively unimportant, and it is a common fallacy that a genocide must run its course, in order for the parties to be interdicted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhere suicide is the intention to kill oneself, (\u003Cem\u003Eregicide the intention to murder a King, fratricide,the intention to kill ones brothers and sisters\u003C\/em\u003E), genocide is the \u0026#8216;\u003Cspan data-huuid=\u002213381093861464492091\u0022\u003Eintent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group\u0026#8217;. What is important here is the \u003Cem\u003Eintention\u003C\/em\u003E to commit genocide, \u003Cem\u003Edolus specialis\u003C\/em\u003E, which makes it an international crime. \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe objective is what makes it a unique crime distinct from national crime statistics like homicide rates, road fatalities and deaths by disease etc. Resorting to overall homicide rates here is a sad attempt to obfuscate murders within a trade or profession. The obvious hate crimes which often precede land invasions, replete with bloodied messaging, use of torture, are disguised and dressed up as mere criminality by the regime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe central claim made by groups such as Afriforum is that farm murders are being ignored by South Africa\u0026#8217;s authorities, who turn a blind eye, by allowing both land invasions, and horrific incidents of slaughter to go unchecked. Instead of investigating, the claims are instantly dismissed as the ravings of white supremacists, and yet every farm murder is a loss to the country\u0026#8217;s productive capacity.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan class=\u0022css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-poiln3\u0022\u003EThe European Union\u0026#8217;s Centre for Information Policy and Security (ECIPS) Ricardo Baretzky\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/news.ecips.eu\/2025\/05\/22\/european-intelligence-backs-trumps-claims-on-south-african-white-genocide\/?s=09\u0022\u003E issued a statement this week\u003C\/a\u003E asserting \u0026#8220;violence against white farmers in South Africa is a verified fact and not misleading. He emphasized that ECIPS\u2019s intelligence confirms the existence of racially motivated attacks and that the phrase \u201cKill the Boer, Kill the Farmer\u201d is more than just rhetoric \u2014 it represents a real and dangerous threat.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003EThink of the outcry if 7 CEOs were murdered in as many months?\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe signing into law of an \u0026#8216;expropriation with nil compensation\u0026#8217; amendment, alongside the condonation of fringe slogans such as \u0026#8216;One Settler on Bullet\u0026#8217; and \u0026#8216;Kill the Boer\u0026#8217; by South Africa\u0026#8217;s apex court, (surely these slogans do not represent our nation\u0026#8217;s collective opposition to apartheid, have no place in the 21st century?) signals that neither Pretoria nor our nations jurists, has an intention of protecting property rights in the country, nor of defending the rights of farmers on the land, who now qualify for asylum in the USA.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYet people like CNN Anderson Cooper and \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2022\/12\/28\/holocaust-denialist-whoopi-goldberg-regales-us-once-more-with-platitudes-on-race\/\u0022\u003EHolocaust denialist Whoopi Goldberg\u003C\/a\u003E were this week parroting a different narrative, the self-same straw-man arguments promoted by Gareth Newham, at the Institute for Security Studies in South Africa, who can see nothing wrong with a \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/www.hrw.org\/reports\/2001\/safrica2\/Safarms7.htm\u0022\u003ETRC submission admitting statements such as \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; drove farm murders\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003E, \u003C\/strong\u003Eas Ramaphosa\u0026#8217;s delegation attempted to spin a fable about crime.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaying \u0026#8216;black and white are murdered equally in South Africa\u0026#8217; is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. South Africa is not only a party to the conflict, a leader on the continent, but earlier this year, almost went to war with Rwanda over the \u003Ca is little respite for the victims of criminality.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: After briefing the meeting about the Congo, where a peace deal between Rwanda and DRC is about to be signed, only a fool would use a page from the briefing to cast shade. Not only did Mokoena repeatedly interject, displaying to the world that she is little more than a propaganda commissar for the SABC, but like Dan Corder, she refused to accept any facts when they arrived. Morgan, was forced to call Mokoena to order when she falsely claimed on air \u0026#8216;not one farm attack has been politically motivated\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECorder on his part, dismissed a well-known TRC finding that the \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; slogan\u00a0 had motivated hate crime, (not current enough), before resorting to his own show as an authority on the subject of contemporary South African crime stats. Corder\u0026#8217;s sources appear to be our government, and his arguments mocking Roet for not complaining about \u0026#8216;abelism\u0026#8217; were indeed facile.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe trouble with government statistics, was first noted by Human Rights Watch which complained about the manner in which South African\u00a0 stats are all lumped into single categories, \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EThe statistics for \u0026#8220;attacks on farms and smallholdings\u0026#8221; are problematic for a number of reasons\u0026#8230; in practice racial issues dominate the way the statistics are collected .. police stations are asked to note \u0026#8220;attacks\u0026#8221; on a non-racial basis.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E In essence, public policy may dictate that hate crimes are simply swept under the carpet in the rush to present our nation as a country where \u0026#8221;citizens experience crime equally\u0026#8221;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELocating independent verification of the forensic data here is\u00a0 problematic given the terrain, the statistics are obviously contested by persons such as Ernst Roets and Afriforum, while our\u00a0 government is quick to release data, purporting to refute claims of under-reporting. To date, no independent audit of the numbers, is available, which by their nature are difficult to verify. Statements like \u0026#8220;South Africa does not experience hate crime\u0026#8221; should be taken with a pinch of salt, there is a good deal of doubt in my mind, given the manner in which issues concerning minorities are being dealt with by my country.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPlease \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/25\/trump-white-genocide-straw-man-or-scare-crow\/\u0022\u003Eread my earlier piece\u003C\/a\u003E on why issues such as magnitude and scale are relatively unimportant when it comes to interdicting the \u0026#8216;crime of genocide\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022jetpack-video-wrapper\u0022\u003E\u003Ciframe loading=\u0022lazy\u0022 title=\u0022\u0026quot;I Said Too Much\u0026quot; Oscar Pistorius BOMBSHELL | Plus Trump South Africa \u0026quot;Genocide\u0026quot;\u0022 width=\u0022780\u0022 height=\u0022439\u0022 src=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/OpnR_ylxQOI?feature=oembed\u0022 frameborder=\u00220\u0022 allow=\u0022accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\u0022 referrerpolicy=\u0022strict-origin-when-cross-origin\u0022 allowfullscreen\u003E\u003C\/iframe\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28913\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EPiers Morgan calls out Sophie Mokoena, Corder throws jelly beans.\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWATCHING last nights Piers Morgan segment featuring Ernst Roets, Gareth Cliff, Dan Corder and Sophie Mokoena, was astonishing. item.content:encoded: {"@context":["https:\/\/www.w3.org\/ns\/activitystreams",{"Hashtag":"as:Hashtag","sensitive":"as:sensitive"}],"id":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?p=28913","type":"Note","attributedTo":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=1","audience":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/?author=0","content":"\u003Ch2\u003EPiers Morgan calls out Sophie Mokoena, Corder throws jelly beans\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWATCHING last nights Piers Morgan segment featuring Ernst Roets, Gareth Cliff, Dan Corder and Sophie Mokoena, was astonishing. Not only did Mokoena repeatedly interject, displaying to the world that she is little more than a propaganda commissar for the SABC, but like Dan Corder, she refused to accept any facts when they arrived. Morgan, was forced to call Mokoena to order when she falsely claimed on air \u0026#8216;not one farm attack has been politically motivated\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECorder on his part, dismissed a well-known TRC finding that the \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; slogan\u00a0 had motivated hate crime, (not current enough), before resorting to his own show as an authority on the subject of contemporary South African crime stats. Corder\u0026#8217;s sources appear to be none other than our government, and his arguments mocking Roets for not complaining about \u0026#8216;abelism\u0026#8217; were indeed facile.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe trouble with government statistics, was first noted by Human Rights Watch which complained about the manner in which South African\u00a0 stats are all lumped into single categories, \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EThe statistics for \u0026#8220;attacks on farms and smallholdings\u0026#8221; are problematic for a number of reasons\u0026#8230; in practice racial issues dominate the way the statistics are collected .. police stations are asked to note \u0026#8220;attacks\u0026#8221; on a non-racial basis.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u00a0 In essence, public policy may dictate that hate crimes are simply swept under the carpet in the rush to present our nation as a country where \u0026#8221;citizens experience crime equally\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELocating independent verification of the forensic data here is problematic given the terrain, with the statistics obviously contested by persons such as Ernst Roets and Afriforum, our government is quick to release data, purporting to refute claims of under-reporting. To date, no independent audit of the numbers, is available, crimes which by their nature are difficult to categorize and verify.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStatements like \u0026#8220;South Africa does not experience hate crime\u0026#8221; should be taken with a pinch of salt, there is a good deal of scepticism in my mind, given the reports and manner in which issues concerning minorities are being dealt with by my country. This week President Ramaphosa announced that the country would continue to deploy race labels, whilst engaging in \u0026#8216;positive discrimination\u0026#8217;, so when it comes to crime, it\u0026#8217;s all about non-racialism, but as for business, we will roll out those labels.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPlease \u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/2025\/05\/25\/trump-white-genocide-straw-man-or-scare-crow\/\u0022\u003Eread my earlier piece\u003C\/a\u003E on why issues such as magnitude and scale are relatively unimportant when it comes to interdicting the \u0026#8216;crime of genocide\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\u0022jetpack-video-wrapper\u0022\u003E\u003Ciframe loading=\u0022lazy\u0022 title=\u0022\u0026quot;I Said Too Much\u0026quot; Oscar Pistorius BOMBSHELL | Plus Trump South Africa \u0026quot;Genocide\u0026quot;\u0022 width=\u0022780\u0022 height=\u0022439\u0022 src=\u0022https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/OpnR_ylxQOI?feature=oembed\u0022 frameborder=\u00220\u0022 allow=\u0022accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share\u0022 referrerpolicy=\u0022strict-origin-when-cross-origin\u0022 allowfullscreen\u003E\u003C\/iframe\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E","context":"https:\/\/medialternatives.com\/wp-json\/activitypub\/1.0\/posts\/28913\/context","contentMap":{"en":"\u003Ch2\u003EPiers Morgan calls out Sophie Mokoena, Corder throws jelly beans\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWATCHING last nights Piers Morgan segment featuring Ernst Roets, Gareth Cliff, Dan Corder and Sophie Mokoena, was astonishing. Morgan, was forced to call Mokoena to order when she falsely claimed on air \u0026#8216;not one farm attack has been politically motivated\u0026#8217;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECorder on his part, dismissed a well-known TRC finding that the \u0026#8220;Kill the Boer\u0026#8221; slogan\u00a0 had motivated hate crime, (not current enough), before resorting to his own show as an authority on the subject of contemporary South African crime stats. Corder\u0026#8217;s sources appear to be none other than our government, and his arguments mocking Roets for not complaining about \u0026#8216;abelism\u0026#8217; were indeed facile.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe trouble with government statistics, first noted by Human Rights Watch which complained about the manner in which South African stats are all lumped into single categories,: \u0026#8220;\u003Cem\u003EThe statistics for \u0026#8220;attacks on farms and smallholdings\u0026#8221; are problematic for a number of reasons\u0026#8230; in practice racial issues dominate the way the statistics are collected .. police stations are asked to note \u0026#8220;attacks\u0026#8221; on a non-racial basis.\u0026#8221;\u003C\/em\u003E\u00a0 In essence, public policy may dictate that hate crimes are simply swept under the carpet in the rush to present our nation as a country where \u0026#8221;citizens experience crime equally\u0026#8221;.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELocating independent verification of the forensic data here is problematic given the terrain, with the statistics obviously contested by persons such as Ernst Roets and Afriforum, our government is quick to release data, purporting to refute claims of under-reporting. To date, no independent audit of the numbers, is available, crimes which by their nature are difficult to categorize and verify.
